The firm is expanding its Data Strategy function to support continued growth of its internal data platform and broader initiatives spanning data engineering, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities. Position Summary This is a hands-on Data Engineering role focused on building, maintaining, and expanding the firm's internal data platform. The position reports directly to the Director of Data Strategy, with a dotted-line relationship to the Lead Data Engineer / Developer. The engineering team is intentionally small, giving this individual meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence how the platform evolves. The successful candidate will work closely with the Lead Data Engineer while taking on core data engineering responsibilities across data ingestion, pipelines, modeling, warehousing, database performance, and data quality. The environment is primarily on-premises and built around  Python, PostgreSQL, and Linux . Responsibilities Build, maintain, and expand data models, ingestion processes, pipelines, and datasets. Design and support reliable ETL/ELT workflows with an emphasis on performance, stability, data quality, and auditability. Develop and maintain data warehouse structures, views, and models supporting reporting, analytics, and data exploration. Work extensively with PostgreSQL, including query optimization, indexes, views, materialized views, functions, and other server-side database objects. Monitor and improve database and pipeline performance, reliability, and data quality. Support secure handling of sensitive data and established data security, governance, and compliance requirements. Participate in technical code reviews and engineering quality practices. Partner directly with internal business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions. Contribute to technical architecture and broader Data Strategy decisions as the platform continues to evolve. Support data infrastructure and integrations associated with emerging AI-enabled capabilities. Collaborate closely with the Lead Data Engineer / Developer, bringing technical perspective, constructive feedback, and independent problem-solving. Maintain technical documentation and contribute to ongoing platform support and continuous improvement. Support production and maintenance work that must be performed after normal business hours, including monthly Saturday patching activities. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional data engineering or closely related engineering experience. Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes. Strong  Python  development skills. Strong  SQL  skills and hands-on experience working with relational databases. Hands-on  PostgreSQL  experience, including database performance and query optimization. Experience developing and maintaining data models and data warehouse structures. Experience working in  Linux  environments. Ability to independently troubleshoot technical and data-related issues. Ability to work directly with business stakeholders and end users to understand requirements without relying exclusively on a Business Analyst or Project Manager. Ability to explain technical concepts and decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working within an on-premises environment; candidates seeking a cloud-only role will not be a fit. Comfortable working within a small engineering team where engineers have meaningful ownership and are expected to bring ideas, ask questions, and challenge approaches when appropriate. Must permanently reside in the United States and be authorized to work in the United States. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience working with on-premises or internally managed data infrastructure. Experience with cloud/on-premises migrations or environments incorporating both cloud and on-premises technologies. Exposure to  Django web app framework and/or FastAPI  through professional or personal projects. Experience with job orchestration, background processing, or scheduling tools such as Celery, Celery Beat, cron, or similar technologies. Broader PostgreSQL database administration or server-side development experience. Experience with Git-based development workflows and collaborative code review. Familiarity with data security concepts, including access controls, encryption, audit logging, and sensitive-data handling. Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar security/compliance frameworks. Experience preparing data or building integrations supporting AI/ML or AI-enabled applications. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar tools while maintaining independent technical judgment. Experience in a startup, consulting, or similarly entrepreneurial environment where engineers work directly with business stakeholders. Experience working with compensation, financial, or other highly sensitive data. Previous remote-work experience. Title:  Software Engineer II Description:   •   Author, maintain, and optimize fraud rules and policies across our real-time fraud decisioning engines to protect customers from account takeover (ATO) and other fraud — this is the core of the role.    •   Contribute significantly to the backend services in the fraud-prevention stack: design and implement features, API changes, and integrations; make production code changes; and help improve their reliability, performance, and quality — not just their rules.    •   Use AI coding tools as a core part of your workflow (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to accelerate both rule authoring and service development — generating, refactoring, and validating rule sets, tests, and service code, always with human review and testing.    • Translate policy and analytics requirements into precise, testable rule logic — tuning thresholds, fraud signals, and link-analysis weights to raise fraud-catch precision while reducing friction for legitimate customers.    • Test changes end-to-end before release using pre-release testing and artifact-deployment tooling, and manage safe production rollouts — including silent/shadow-mode validation and change-request approvals.    • Contribute to engineering quality across the stack: design docs, code reviews, automated tests, CI/CD, and observability.    • Support monitoring, on-call, and rapid issue resolution in production, using observability dashboards to track service health, rule performance, latency, and match rates.    • Collaborate closely with Policy, Analytics, Data Science, and Product partners to respond to emerging fraud attacks and continuously improve detection coverage.     Skills:  Required 2 years of professional software engineering experience building and contributing to backend services SWE2 level.

skills.source: Request ID: 111892-1  Title: Java Full Stack Developer  Locations: Weehawken, NJ  Duration: 06 Months  Pay Range: $30-$55/Hour on W2/C2C (All inclusive)     Role Descriptions:  We are looking for an experienced Java Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in Java| Spring Boot| Microservices| and React JS. The candidate will be responsible for designing| developing| and maintaining scalable web applications| collaborating with cross-functional teams| and delivering high-quality software solutions.     Key Responsibilities:  Develop and maintain scalable enterprise applications using Java| Spring Boot| and React JS. Design and develop RESTful APIs and Microservices. Build responsive and interactive user interfaces using React JS. Participate in solution design| code reviews| and technical discussions. Integrate front-end applications with backend services and databases. Write clean| reusable| and maintainable code following best practices. Perform unit testing| integration testing| and debugging. Implement security| performance optimization| and reliability standards. Work in Agile/Scrum development environments.    You will:  • design and develop scalable backend services in Java and responsive user interfaces in React  • contribute to distributed systems, cloud architecture, and microservice design  • deliver maintainable, secure, and high-quality software  • write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests  • analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions  • participate in architecture, platform design, and technical decision-making  • investigate production issues and implement sustainable improvements  • create and maintain technical documentation  Your team  You will join a cross-functional engineering team responsible for developing and supporting OneSource web services. You will work closely with engineers, architects, product stakeholders, business analysts, testers, and platform teams.  Your expertise  You bring:  • strong backend development experience with Java, Spring Framework / Spring Batch / Spring Boot  • experience with Cloud native technology (Microservices, container technology) and DevOps  • strong frontend development experience with React, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS  • experience designing and developing REST APIs and microservices  • a solid understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native architecture  • experience with relational databases (Sybase or MSSQL, Oracle), data modeling, and strong SQL skills  • strong automated testing and software-quality practices  • accustomed with Agile Methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.)  • knowledge of Git, CI/CD, secure coding, and production support  • experience analyzing business requirements and documenting technical solutions  • strong ownership, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills  Experience with Client Azure, containerized platforms, Kubernetes, event-driven systems, observability tools, and large client-facing applications would be an advantage.     Mandatory Skills:  Backend Java 8/11/17Spring BootSpring MVC Spring Security Microservices Architecture REST API Development Hibernate / JPA Maven / Gradle Frontend React JS Java Script (ES6+)TypeScriptHTML5CSS3Bootstrap / Material UIRedux / Context API Database SQL Oracle / PostgreSQL / MySQL DevOps & Tools Git/GitHub/GitLab Jenkins / CI-CD Docker Kubernetes     Good to have:  Sonar Qube Cloud (Preferred)Azure / AWS Azure DevOps  Kafka / RabbitMQGraphQLTerraformOpenShiftOAuth2 / JWT Authentication Performance tuning and monitoring tools     Experience Required:  6-8

evidence.text: Delivered Fortune 500 Java systems for Fidelity, British Telecom and T-Mobile over 3 years spanning secure insurance exchange, telecom commerce and an AWS operations platform for 3K employees.

skills.source: plaintext JOB SUMMARY Supports the organization’s digital strategy and business operations by designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining secure, scalable web and mobile applications that improve the experience of members and employees. This role builds and supports internal and external digital platforms—including public websites, intranet, extranet, and digital banking applications—using Optimizely CMS/Commerce (DXP) and Microsoft technologies such as C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, WCF, Razor, and ADO.NET, along with modern front-end frameworks including JavaScript, ReactJS, jQuery, Bootstrap, HTML, and CSS. Working in an Agile environment, the position collaborates with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, participate in architecture and design discussions, develop reusable components and APIs, integrate backend systems and databases (SQL Server and Oracle), and ensure applications meet performance, security, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities .NET Application Development: Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade websites and applications using Microsoft technologies including C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET MVC, with preferred experience in Optimizely CMS/Commerce and Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Build and support enterprise applications using n-tier architecture and established design patterns within the Microsoft technology stack. Front-End Development & User Experience: Develop responsive and accessible user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, ReactJS, Bootstrap, HTML5, and CSS3. Collaborate with UX designers and stakeholders to deliver intuitive digital experiences. Utilize design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite to support UI/UX design validation, usability testing, and iterative design improvements. API Development & Systems Integration: Design and implement SOAP and RESTful APIs using Microsoft technologies including WCF and ASP.NET Web API. Integrate applications with backend systems and services using .NET, OLE DB, and other enterprise data access technologies. Ensure secure, scalable, and reliable system integrations across internal and external platforms. Database Development & Data Modeling: Collaborate with database developers to support data modeling, schema design, and performance optimization. Contribute to database development tasks using Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle as required. Agile Development & Cross-Team Collaboration: Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. Manage development activities using Team Foundation Server (TFS), Azure DevOps, or other enterprise project management tools. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Marketing and IT— including Project Management, Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Database Administration—as well as onsite and offshore resources to ensure successful solution delivery, alignment with business objectives, and ongoing operational support. Testing, Optimization & Development Standards: Perform unit testing, debugging, performance tuning, and code refactoring to ensure high-quality and maintainable software. Adhere to organizational coding standards, documentation requirements, and secure development practices. Maintain accurate task tracking, code changes, and version control using Git or other enterprise source control systems. Platform Support & Website Maintenance: Support and enhance internal and external digital platforms, including intranet, extranet, public websites, and digital banking applications. Ensure applications meet availability, reliability, and performance standards in accordance with service level agreements (SLAs). Provide troubleshooting and technical support for application-related issues and user requests. Serve as backup administrator for Windows-based web servers when required. Security, Compliance & Documentation: Ensure compliance with organizational policies related to data protection, cybersecurity, network security, and antivirus standards. Maintain accurate service records, system documentation, configuration documentation, and knowledge base articles. Contribute to operational documentation and system runbooks supporting application environments. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science Knowledge of financial/banking industry 3+ years of software development experience on the Microsoft technology stack. 3+ years of backend development experience using C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Razor, and ADO.NET. 3+ years of front-end development experience building responsive and interactive user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap (or similar frameworks). Experience designing and implementing user-centric web applications, with a strong focus on usability and overall UI/UX experience. 3+ years of database development experience using T-SQL with Microsoft SQL Server. 2+ years of experience developing and consuming web services and APIs, including REST and/or SOAP using Web API or WCF. Preferred Qualifications Experience illustrating design concepts through storyboards, workflow diagrams, wireframes, and UI mockup Experience implementing complex business workflows and enterprise application logic. Knowledge of secure application development practices, including implementing security controls in .NET applications and web servers. Familiarity with modern front-end development tools Experience developing solutions using Optimizely CMS/Commerce or Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar libraries.

This role builds and supports internal and external digital platforms—including public websites, intranet, extranet, and digital banking applications—using Optimizely CMS/Commerce (DXP) and Microsoft technologies such as C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, WCF, Razor, and ADO.NET, along with modern front-end frameworks including JavaScript, ReactJS, jQuery, Bootstrap, HTML, and CSS. Working in an Agile environment, the position collaborates with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, participate in architecture and design discussions, develop reusable components and APIs, integrate backend systems and databases (SQL Server and Oracle), and ensure applications meet performance, security, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities .NET Application Development: Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade websites and applications using Microsoft technologies including C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET MVC, with preferred experience in Optimizely CMS/Commerce and Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Build and support enterprise applications using n-tier architecture and established design patterns within the Microsoft technology stack. Front-End Development & User Experience: Develop responsive and accessible user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, ReactJS, Bootstrap, HTML5, and CSS3. Collaborate with UX designers and stakeholders to deliver intuitive digital experiences. Utilize design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite to support UI/UX design validation, usability testing, and iterative design improvements. API Development & Systems Integration: Design and implement SOAP and RESTful APIs using Microsoft technologies including WCF and ASP.NET Web API. Integrate applications with backend systems and services using .NET, OLE DB, and other enterprise data access technologies. Ensure secure, scalable, and reliable system integrations across internal and external platforms. Database Development & Data Modeling: Collaborate with database developers to support data modeling, schema design, and performance optimization. Contribute to database development tasks using Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle as required. Agile Development & Cross-Team Collaboration: Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. Manage development activities using Team Foundation Server (TFS), Azure DevOps, or other enterprise project management tools. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Marketing and IT— including Project Management, Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Database Administration—as well as onsite and offshore resources to ensure successful solution delivery, alignment with business objectives, and ongoing operational support. Testing, Optimization & Development Standards: Perform unit testing, debugging, performance tuning, and code refactoring to ensure high-quality and maintainable software. Adhere to organizational coding standards, documentation requirements, and secure development practices. Maintain accurate task tracking, code changes, and version control using Git or other enterprise source control systems. Platform Support & Website Maintenance: Support and enhance internal and external digital platforms, including intranet, extranet, public websites, and digital banking applications. Ensure applications meet availability, reliability, and performance standards in accordance with service level agreements (SLAs). Provide troubleshooting and technical support for application-related issues and user requests. Serve as backup administrator for Windows-based web servers when required. Security, Compliance & Documentation: Ensure compliance with organizational policies related to data protection, cybersecurity, network security, and antivirus standards. Maintain accurate service records, system documentation, configuration documentation, and knowledge base articles. Contribute to operational documentation and system runbooks supporting application environments. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science Knowledge of financial/banking industry 3+ years of software development experience on the Microsoft technology stack. 3+ years of backend development experience using C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Razor, and ADO.NET. 3+ years of front-end development experience building responsive and interactive user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap (or similar frameworks). Experience designing and implementing user-centric web applications, with a strong focus on usability and overall UI/UX experience. 3+ years of database development experience using T-SQL with Microsoft SQL Server. 2+ years of experience developing and consuming web services and APIs, including REST and/or SOAP using Web API or WCF. Preferred Qualifications Experience illustrating design concepts through storyboards, workflow diagrams, wireframes, and UI mockup Experience implementing complex business workflows and enterprise application logic. Knowledge of secure application development practices, including implementing security controls in .NET applications and web servers. Familiarity with modern front-end development tools Experience developing solutions using Optimizely CMS/Commerce or Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar libraries.

skills.label: Java
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Backend Developer   Location(s):  Pleasanton, CA.       Core Responsibilities:     Design, build, optimize, and maintain scalable, resilient, and high-performance backend systems using Java, Kotlin, and other JVM-based technologies.   Develop, enhance, and maintain RESTful APIs with strong adherence to security, performance, and reliability standards.   Implement services using Spring Boot, Quarkus, and modern web technologies, following 12-factor app principles for cloud-native development.   Integrate and manage event-driven architecture using Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.   Work with PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases, ensuring efficient schema design, performance optimization, and reliability.   Utilize Git, GitHub, and GitHub Actions for version control, CI/CD automation, and deployment pipelines.   Build and deploy containerized applications using Docker and orchestrate them on Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, or equivalent).   Collaborate cross-functionally within Agile/SCRUM teams, contributing to sprint planning, estimation, and delivery.   Ensure adherence to secure coding practices, SDLC standards, and compliance frameworks.   Monitor and enhance system performance using alerting and observability tools such as Nagios, New Relic, Splunk, or GCP monitoring.   Work with public cloud platforms (Azure or OCI) for application deployment, scaling, and operational readiness.   If required, contribute to Salesforce Development (SFDC) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) or other platforms such as Shopify, SFCC, Stibo, or SFSC.     Required Skills and Qualifications:     Strong proficiency in Java, Kotlin, JVM-based development, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), and robust exception-handling practices.   Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Quarkus, and modern backend web technologies.   Expertise in event-streaming and messaging platforms such as Apache Kafka and/or RabbitMQ.   Solid experience developing and maintaining REST APIs and microservices architectures.   Proficiency with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) as required.   Strong understanding of Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, and other DevOps tools (Chef, Jenkins, Puppet, ArgoCD).   Practical experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, especially PostgreSQL and MongoDB.   Working knowledge of containerization (Docker) and Kubernetes orchestration (AKS, GKE).   Understanding of public cloud platforms including Azure and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).   Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (Nagios, New Relic, Splunk, GCP Monitoring).   Familiarity with 12-factor app methodology and modern cloud-native design principles.   Knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Agile/SCRUM methods, and industry best practices.           Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Software Dev Engineer I.   Location:  Seattle, WA.         Job Description:     Client Payment Products team is looking for developers to design and build next generation global payments solutions that revolutionize the way customers pay. The Client Payments Team manages all Client branded payment offerings, globally.    These offerings are growing rapidly and we are continuously adding new market-leading features and launching new products. Our payments products (Client Co-Branded Credit Cards, Private Labeled Credit Cards, Non-Client Branded Credit Cards, Shop with Points and Foreign Exchange) provide the most innovative payment experience on and off Client.   As we build innovative payments solutions for our customers, the role provides a huge opportunity for the developers to build a strong portfolio of patents for Client. The role will also include defining and implementing extensible, multi-faceted solutions that support global and region specific payments specific protocols and workflows. This is a critical program for Consumer Payments, with high leadership visibility, and opportunity for delivering significant business value.   We are looking for passionate, experienced software developers that can lead a team of developers in delivering high quality software solutions to support variety of customer use cases and are scalable to handle Client volume.   Developers in the team need a strong understanding of Computer fundamentals and practical experience in building full stack, large scale distributed systems. Experience with web-based applications and/or web services-based applications, especially at massive scale, is also helpful.     Key job responsibilities:     Develop and maintain backend services.   Create and optimize rendering solutions for multiple channels.   Design and develop APIs for system integration.   Write clean, maintainable code following best practices.   Implement monitoring and alerting mechanisms.   Optimize system performance for high-traffic applications.   Contribute to continuous improvement of development practices.                       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.source: Software Engineer - Java Developer 6 Month Contract to Hire Fully onsite in Wilmington, DE 19803 Only candidates who can convert Full Time without sponsorship will be considered About the Role As a Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable systems that power business‑critical applications. You will work in cross‑functional teams to solve complex technical problems, improve system performance, and continuously enhance product quality through modern engineering practices. Responsibilities Design, build, and support scalable, resilient backend systems using Java with a focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability. Write high‑quality, secure, production‑ready code and contribute to code reviews, testing, and debugging activities. Participate in end‑to‑end software development, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support. Contribute to system architecture and design documentation while ensuring alignment with technical and business requirements. Analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, surface insights, and drive continuous improvement in systems and coding practices. Identify and address system bottlenecks, hidden issues, and architectural risks to improve application stability and scalability. Collaborate with engineering peers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions. Stay current with emerging technologies and contribute to engineering best practices, communities of practice, and knowledge sharing. Foster an inclusive, respectful, and collaborative team environment. Minimum Qualifications Practical experience in software engineering, including system design, application development, testing, and production support. Proficiency in Java and experience building backend services or distributed systems. Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining code in large‑scale or enterprise environments. Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Experience with agile development practices, including CI/CD, application resiliency, and security best practices. Familiarity with at least one technical domain such as cloud computing, distributed systems, data platforms, or related areas. Preferred Qualifications Experience with modern front‑end technologies. Exposure to cloud‑based architectures and services. Familiarity with technologies such as AWS, Cassandra, Kafka, RESTful APIs, Terraform, Spring Boot, performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner), and observability platforms (e.g., Dynatrace) is a plus.

evidence.text: Delivered Fortune 500 Java systems for Fidelity, British Telecom and T-Mobile over 3 years spanning secure insurance exchange, telecom commerce and an AWS operations platform for 3K employees.

Integrate telemetry and observability (logging, metrics, tracing) and establish SLOs for model services.   Monitor model and data drift; automate retraining, evaluation, and safe rollout/rollback workflows.   Collaborate with software engineers to integrate ML services into client applications and shared platforms.   Champion best practices for code quality, reproducibility, and governance (model registry, artifacts, approvals).            Required Qualifications:     Strong Python engineering skills and production experience building services with FastAPI.   Proven MLOps experience: packaging, serving, scaling, and maintaining models as APIs.   Hands-on CI/CD for ML (GitHub Enterprise or similar), including automated testing and release pipelines.   Containerization and orchestration expertise (Docker, Kubernetes) with production deployments on AKS.   GitOps experience with Argo CD; practical knowledge of deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, rollback).   Solid understanding of RESTful API design, microservices patterns, and API contract governance.   Experience designing or contributing to an MLOps platform (standards, templates, tooling) for repeatable delivery.   Ability to work cross-functionally with data scientists, software, and platform/SRE teams.       Preferred Qualifications:     Minimum 2+ years related experience.   Experience with ML lifecycle tools (MLflow or similar for tracking/registry) and feature stores.   Exposure to Databricks and enterprise data/compute environments.   Cloud experience on Azure (preferred), plus GCP familiarity and managed ML services.   Familiarity with Agile practices; experience with Helm/Kustomize, secrets management, and security scanning.              Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Key Responsibilities Develop high-quality, maintainable, and well-documented software solutions following industry best practices Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and documentation efforts Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, develop features, test functionality, and support deployment and training Adhere to established project management methodologies, documentation protocols, and continuous improvement practices Required Skills & Experience Strong backend development experience using the Java ecosystem Proficiency in frontend development with AngularJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, or React Solid understanding of software engineering principles, system design, and lifecycle management Experience building RESTful APIs and implementing ETL processes Proficient in relational databases such as Oracle or PostgreSQL Familiarity with server administration in both Windows and Linux environments Effective communication and collaboration skills Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and challenges Preferred Qualifications Experience with CI/CD tools and frameworks such as Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Git Exposure to bioinformatics or cheminformatics technologies and algorithms Familiarity with Test Driven Development (TDD) using tools like Karma or Jasmine Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 3+ years of relevant experience OR Master’s degree in a related field with 2+ years of relevant experience  			  			 Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.

evidence.text: Jenkins Docker Kubernetes CI/CD for 20 engineers; deploy 6h to 90s; 20+ releases/month.

Familiarity with Jenkins for CI/CD practices is also beneficial.   Understanding of backend automation techniques will be advantageous.   Experience with cloud technologies can further strengthen a candidates profile.   Any additional experience in AI-related projects would be a plus.   Candidates must have strong experience in Java and Spring Boot| as these are critical for the development of applications.   Additionally| knowledge of Agentic AI applications is mandatory. Proficiency in SQL with Oracle and PostgreSQL is also required.   Familiarity with ReST API development and Event-Driven Architecture is essential. Experience with Kafka and CI/CD concepts is a plus.       Company Benefits & Culture   •    Inclusive and diverse work environment  •    Opportunities for professional growth and development  •    Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.        Job Title:  Java Full Stack Developer.   Location:  McLean, VA.          About the Project     We are seeking a skilled Java Full Stack Developer to join our team for a long-term project. This role focuses on enhancing and maintaining an internal application currently in production.    The application is used by internal developers and is not tied to critical functions such as login or enrollment.    The contractor will primarily work on API enhancements and application maintenance, with opportunities to contribute to AI initiatives involving large language models (LLMs) and knowledge base integration.     Key Responsibilities:     Backend Development (80%)     Enhance and maintain two internal APIs.   Implement new features and improvements in the backend using Java, Spring, REST, and AWS.   Ensure code quality, scalability, and reliability.   Collaborate with internal teams to support production systems.       UI Development (20%)     Maintain and enhance the UI-based application.   Work with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Angular for front-end tasks.       AI Initiatives     Participate in projects integrating LLMs.   Contribute to building and querying the internal knowledge base.   Explore opportunities to apply AI solutions within the application ecosystem.         Required Skills:     Strong proficiency in Java, Spring, REST APIs, and AWS.   Ability to confidently read, write, and debug code.   Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Angular for UI tasks.   Familiarity with production application support and maintenance.   Interest in AI/ML concepts and willingness to learn and contribute to AI-driven initiatives.     Ideal Candidate:     3 years of professional experience in backend development.   Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.   Comfortable working in a collaborative environment with internal developer teams.   Curious and adaptable, with a desire to explore emerging technologies like AI.                 Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Python Developer     Location(s):  Richmond, VA       Job Description:     We are looking for a passionate Python Developer to join our team.   You will be responsible for developing and implementing high-quality software solutions, creating complex applications using cutting-edge programming features and frameworks and collaborating with other teams in the firm to define, design and ship new features.   As an active part of our company, you will brainstorm and chalk out solutions to suit our requirements and meet our business goals. You will also be working on data engineering problems and building data pipelines. You would get ample opportunities to work on challenging and innovative projects, using the latest technologies and tools.   If you enjoy working in a fast-paced and collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting role. We offer industry-standard compensation packages, relocation assistance, and professional growth and development opportunities.     Objectives of this role     Develop, test and maintain high-quality software using Python programming language.   Participate in the entire software development lifecycle, building, testing and delivering high-quality solutions.   Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and solve complex problems.   Write clean and reusable code that can be easily maintained and scaled.   Create large-scale data processing pipelines to help developers build and train Client machine learning algorithms.   Participate in code reviews, ensure code quality and identify areas for improvement to implement practical solutions.   Debugging codes when required and troubleshooting any Python-related queries.   Keep up to date with emerging trends and technologies in Python development.     Required skills and qualifications     3+ years of experience as a Python Developer with a strong portfolio of projects.   Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.   Strong expertise with Python, AWS, Stepfunctions, Lambda.   In-depth understanding of the Python software development stacks, ecosystems, frameworks and tools such as Numpy, Scipy, Pandas, Dask, spaCy, NLTK, sci-kit-learn and PyTorch.   Experience with front-end development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.   Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL and NoSQL.   Excellent problem-solving ability with solid communication and collaboration skills.     Preferred skills and qualifications     Experience with popular Python frameworks such as Django, Flask or Pyramid.   Knowledge of data science and machine learning concepts and tools.   Contributions to open-source Python projects or active involvement in the Python community.         Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: Python / JavaScript
skills.source: Strong programming skills in Python and JavaScript, with solid experience in at least one of: Java, PowerShell, or C#; comfortable switching across languages and technology stacks to contribute to multiple active projects simultaneously. Hands-on experience developing automation and security workflows, dedicating a significant portion of time to building software and integrations for data protection initiatives. Strong experience with Endpoint. Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python and PowerShell for task automation, system administration, security operations workflows, and integration with enterprise platforms (e.g., Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure). Manage DLP tools, including configuring policies, tuning, testing, and implementing new features and functionality. Provide support across multiple areas of data security and operations: Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data minimization, data discovery, cloud data protection, Privileged Access Management (PAM), data privacy, data labeling, data classification and rights management, data encryption, and data access governance. Manage the technical configuration, implementation, administration, and support of multiple data security products and solutions such as CASB, SASE, DLP, and DSPM. Develop technical documentation (e.g., system designs, architecture diagrams, data flows, functional specifications). Leverage APIs to collect key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) for data governance and protection controls. Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams including Security Operations, Legal, Privacy, Data and Analytics, Enterprise Architecture, Platform teams, and sector functions. Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) to deploy and operate security and data protection solutions. Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git), CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools to accelerate delivery and maintenance of security capabilities. Experience using data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Looker, QuickSight) to create dashboards and insights for KPIs and KRIs related to data security. Ability to analyze security telemetry and operational data to generate actionable insights that drive program decisions and risk mitigation strategies. Solid background and understanding of security concepts such as data classification, data loss prevention (DLP) strategies , data discovery, data masking, rights management, data residency, cloud data protection, and regulatory compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, PCI-DSS). 3+ years in data security, data loss prevention (DLP), software development, or computer engineering; or master's degree in computer science/engineering or related data security field, and 1 year of relevant experience.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.label: Agile
skills.source: Differentiating Behaviors Skilled in leading complex technical projects with expertise in cybersecurity, software engineering, agile methods, and customer interaction. Proficient in evaluating the relative costs, benefits, and trade-offs of potential courses of action to pinpoint the optimal solution. Skilled in task organization, time management, and prioritization to align actions with business objectives. Meticulous attention to detail, adept at articulating crucial specifics clearly in both verbal discourse and technical documentation. Proficient in cultivating cooperative, transparent working partnerships with technology teams and various stakeholders, including vendor relationships. Skilled at translating complex technical findings and risk assessments into clear, concise narratives tailored to executive, legal, or non-technical stakeholders. Effective communication skills, capable of conveying information clearly and engaging with technical and non-technical audiences across various levels. Information Security certifications such as CEH, CISM, CISA, Security+, Network+, CISSP, OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT, GXPN, and GSE are a plus, but not required. Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end automation and workflow solutions for data security, from idea and design through implementation and continuous improvement. Experience leveraging PowerShell scripting to automate repetitive security tasks, generate operational reports, and integrate with enterprise security tooling. Proven experience leading or contributing to multiple concurrent security or data protection projects, balancing hands-on technical work with stakeholder alignment and risk-based prioritization.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Full Stack Developer   Location(s):  San Francisco, CA.         Job Description:     Provides strategic direction and executes on infrastructure, security, continuous integration, deployment, and IT operations practices, scaling and metrics.   Runs day-to-day operations of production and development infrastructure for a cloud-based commerce platform.   Develops an innovative approach to simplify and streamline processes to increase system scalability and reliability, improve efficiency, and minimize errors.   Works with the Development and QA teams to provide continuous improvement of existing features and rollout of new services, ensuring high availability of our platform.     Expertise:     Java, Spring boot, Azure, CDP AKS, Kafka, MogoDB, AI(Copilot, Codex, Claude).     Skill Set:     Strong in Linux and Windows. Experience supporting web applications (Ruby and Java based preferred).   Scripting (Ruby, Perl, Python, Bash, Awk, PHP). Elastic Cloud / Virtualization (ESXi ,EC2, Rackspace Cloud, Hypervisor, KVM, Xen, VDI).   Build Automation (Jenkins, Hudson, Cruisecontrol, Electric Commander).   Systems automation and provisioning frameworks (Chef, Puppet, Cfengine, Babushka, Knife, Mcollective, Func, Kickstart, PXE). Large Scale Databases (MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, HBase, Cassandra, Hadoop).   Test Driven Development (junit/phpunit/RSpec/Cucumber). Middleware (MQ).   Caching strategy (CDN, Varnish, memcached, Redis).   Familiar with high availability strategies (haproxy, Global Traffic Management / Multiple Datacenters, Geo DNS, failable architecture).   Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) support. Monitoring systems and frameworks (Nagios, Ganglia, CollectD, Graphite). Performance testing and analysis.   Package management workflows (Aptitude/dpkg, Yum/RPM). Single Sign On Technologies (LDAP, Kerberos, Open Directory, PAM).   Common Unix Systems Services (NFS, NTP, Apache, nginx). Security frameworks (IP Tables, Nessus, nmap). F5 BIG-IP, Vipirion.   Able to work in an Agile environment. Critical thinker with a research-oriented problem solving approach. REST API’s using XML and JSON. IBM 4690 OS.   Familiar with high availability strategies (haproxy, Global Traffic Management / Multiple Datacenters, Geo DNS, failable architecture), AI Technologies/Tools in Development framework.              Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.source: Location: Chicago, IL - need local candidates only   Salary Range: 40-45/hr on W2   Introduction   Client is seeking Software Engineers to join its enterprise CI/CD and Developer Tooling organization. The team is responsible for managing and supporting CI/CD tooling used by engineering teams across the enterprise. This is a backend-focused software engineering and platform engineering role involving development, automation, cloud infrastructure tooling, CI/CD pipelines, troubleshooting, and internal developer support.   Required Skills & Qualifications     Strong hands-on experience with  Python  development or automation.   Experience with  AWS CDK .   Experience with  Boto3  or AWS SDKs.   Hands-on Jenkins administration or operational management experience.   Experience with  Groovy  and Jenkins Pipeline.   Experience with  TypeScript .   Experience with  Java or Go .   Experience with  Docker  and containerized applications.   Experience with  Amazon ECS .   Experience with  AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, and Fargate .   Experience with  Terraform  or other Infrastructure as Code tools.   Experience supporting enterprise developer platforms or internal engineering tools.   Experience with vulnerability management, compliance requirements, and software/platform upgrades.   Experience working with  AWS  cloud services.   Hands-on experience with  Infrastructure as Code (IaC) .   Strong understanding of  CI/CD concepts and deployment pipelines .   Experience with  Jenkins .   Experience developing or supporting backend applications, automation tools, or developer platforms.   Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills.   Ability to work across multiple technologies and learn new tools quickly.   Strong communication and collaboration skills.   Must have previous client experience working for this customer in the past 5 years.     Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Experience with vulnerability management, compliance requirements, and software/platform upgrades.   Experience working with  AWS  cloud services.   Hands-on experience with  Infrastructure as Code (IaC) .     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Design, develop, enhance, and maintain software components supporting enterprise CI/CD platforms.   Develop automation and backend tooling primarily using  Python .   Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using  Jenkins  and related technologies.   Troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, automation problems, and platform-related incidents.   Work with  AWS  services and cloud automation frameworks.   Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions for standardized infrastructure provisioning.   Work extensively with  AWS CDK  and AWS SDKs such as  Boto3 .   Support and maintain Jenkins environments, including pipeline configuration, troubleshooting, and operational maintenance.   Develop Jenkins pipelines and automation using  Groovy  where required.   Work with container technologies such as  Docker and Amazon ECS .   Support AWS services including  Lambda, DynamoDB, and Fargate .   Address vulnerabilities, security requirements, compliance-related upgrades, and platform maintenance activities.   Investigate issues reported by internal engineering teams and provide technical solutions or workarounds.   Identify and fix bugs within internal developer tools and automation platforms.   Collaborate with software engineers, platform engineers, DevOps teams, and other technology groups.   Participate in rotating assignments involving customer support, debugging, platform development, and maintenance.   Document technical solutions and contribute to continuous improvement of enterprise developer tooling.     Company Benefits & Culture     Comprehensive health and wellness benefits.   Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.   Inclusive and collaborative work environment.     For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Request ID: 109156-1  Title: AI-Native Software Engineer  Location: San Jose CA or Raleigh NC (onsite)  Duration: 6 months  Pay Range: $45 - $50/Hour on W2/C2C (All inclusive)    JOB DESCRIPTION:      Responsibilities:  You have proven experience serving as a software engineer for web application projects, hosted On-Prem and Cloud, supporting a large customer base.  You know when to build and when to reach for a managed AWS service you can justify that trade-off based on the problem.  You think in systems and evaluate designs critically whether reviewing AI-generated code or your own architecture catching the subtle bug, security gap, or design choice that won't hold up under load or misuse.  You use spec-driven development with AI as your default way of engineering software.  You treat performance as a design constraint, not a tuning pass after the fact.  You pick up new tools and approaches quickly, since the effective way to work with AI changes often, and you'd rather adapt early than fall behind.  You are decisive without being divisive you can analytically weigh trade-offs, balance competing priorities, and drive decisions that span organizational boundaries.  You have excellent communication and organization skills.      Minimum Qualifications:  BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or demonstrated equivalent experience.  Demonstrated fluency in leveraging AI technologies across the entire software development lifecycle, including breaking down user stories into actionable tasks, AI-assisted coding and  testing, automated defect resolution, and deployment of fully tested software.  Deep, hands-on experience building and deploying production systems on AWS (e.g., EC2, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, API Gateway), with a record of real, customer-facing applications running in production.  Server-side software development experience with Python, Java, NodeJS, and/or other similar technologies; client-side web application development experience using React, Backbone, native JavaScript, and/or other comparable technologies.  Expertise in building secure, large-scale systems using fault-tolerant technologies (such as Elasticsearch, CockroachDB, Oracle, MongoDB & Kafka).  AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer) and/or CISSP/CCSP or similar security certification useful, not required.        Company Benefits & Culture  Opportunity to work with a dynamic team in a fast-paced environment  Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and methodologies  Supportive and collaborative work culture      Appreciate your quick response and please feel free to reach me out for any query you may have.      Thanks

Thanks

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.    Project Overview   We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer for a consulting role to support ongoing and future projects. The consultant will be instrumental in developing and maintaining sophisticated applications using .NET Core and Python for backend development, and React or NextJS for frontend development. This role requires significant expertise in deploying applications to Azure App Services, managing code repositories via DevOps or GitHub, and utilizing Azure managed identities for secure resource access. Additionally, the candidate should have comprehensive knowledge of Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication.   Job Functions & Responsibilities     Develop, test, and maintain high-quality web applications using .NET Core and Python.   Design and implement responsive and dynamic user interfaces using React or NextJS.   Implement RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party services.   Collaborate closely with our teams and stakeholders to gather requirements, provide technical insights, and translate them into detailed technical specifications.   Utilize DevOps or GitHub for efficient version control, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes.   Deploy and manage applications on Azure App Services, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and reliability.   Implement and manage Azure managed identities to ensure secure access to resources.   Integrate Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication into applications to manage user identities and access securely.   Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex application issues to maintain high performance and responsiveness.   Conduct thorough code reviews to uphold code quality standards and foster knowledge-sharing within the team.   Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously enhance development practices.   Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers, fostering a collaborative and innovative team environment.   Adapt to various projects and client needs, demonstrating flexibility and expertise in consulting engagements.   Communicate effectively with clients to understand their requirements and deliver solutions that meet their business objectives.     Skills     Extensive experience in backend development using .NET Core and Python.   Advanced proficiency in frontend technologies such as React or NextJS.   Strong knowledge of RESTful API development and integration with third-party services.   Familiarity with SQL Server or other relational databases and ORM frameworks.   Deep understanding of version control systems and CI/CD pipelines, specifically using DevOps or GitHub.   Expertise in deploying and managing applications on Azure App Services.   Strong knowledge of Azure managed identities for secure and efficient resource access.   Comprehensive knowledge of Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication for managing user identities and access securely.   Exceptional problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues.   Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.   Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.   Ability to adapt to different projects and client needs, demonstrating flexibility and expertise in consulting engagements.   Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with the latest technological advancements.     Education & Certifications     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required.   Professional certifications in .NET, Python, React, Azure, or DevOps are highly desirable.   Additional certifications or specialized training in cloud computing, particularly Azure, will be considered an advantage.     Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Please see job description attached!  *** is looking for an AI Engineer to design, build and run the agents that automate work across our digital commerce and transformation programs. The role is hands-on and product-minded: you take a business workflow, decide where an agent genuinely helps, and deliver a governed agent that people use every day. The work is built primarily on Client's AI platform, spanning Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Client Copilot Studio and the Client 365 and Teams surfaces where our teams already work.   This is a production engineering role rather than a prototyping one. Agents you build are expected to clear the *** Agentic Framework bar before they reach users: registered in the Agent Registry, authenticated through Client Entra, authorized under least-privilege RBAC, instrumented for observability, and certified through evaluation testing. You own that path end to end, from the first system prompt and tool schema through deployment, monitoring and iteration.   You will work alongside program managers, data engineers, BI developers, solution architects and security partners, and you will spend as much time defining what good looks like as writing code. Strong candidates are comfortable with ambiguity, opinionated about evaluation, and able to explain in plain language what an agent can do, what it cannot, and how they know.  What We Look For in a Candidate  Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience.  Four or more years of software engineering experience, including at least one year building LLM-based or agent-based applications that reached production users.  Strong Python skills, with C# or TypeScript an advantage, and fluency with asynchronous APIs, REST and GraphQL, JSON schemas and Git-based workflows.  Hands-on experience with Client AI services, including Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and at least one of Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or the Client Agent Framework.  Practical retrieval-augmented generation experience covering chunking strategy, embeddings, vector search, reranking and retrieval evaluation.  Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol or comparable tool-calling and function-calling patterns, including schema design and versioning.  Demonstrated skill in prompt and context engineering, including system prompts, few-shot design and model-specific behavior.  Experience evaluating LLM systems with offline and online methods, regression suites and human review loops, and a clear point of view on what is worth measuring.  Familiarity with Client Entra ID, OAuth2 and JWT, role-based access control and API gateway patterns.  Experience with CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code and observability tooling such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights and OpenTelemetry.  Clear written communication, including the ability to explain agent behavior, limits and failure modes to partners who are not engineers.  Sound judgment about where an agent is the right answer, and the willingness to say plainly when it is not.  Also valuable  Client certification such as Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or an Azure architecture credential.  Experience with Power Platform, including Power Automate and Dataverse, or with Client Fabric and Power BI.  Telecommunications, order management, billing or business-to-business commerce domain experience.  Contributions to agent platform tooling, registries, evaluation frameworks or internal developer experience.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science,      Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. lost.source: Title: Data Analyst II      Duration: 3 months      Location : Remote worker located in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Chicago, IL.      Only looking for W2 candidates          Partner with MDS in providing accessibility, retrievability, security and protection of data in an ethical manner. Support for scoping, building, testing, and maintaining transport/data pipelines and retrieving applicable data sets for specific use cases.    Support building, testing, and maintaining data models with the flexibility to change when business requirements change, while also reconciling multiple logical source models into a single, logically consistent model.    Analyze the structure, format, and reliability of new and existing data sources, considering factors such as data integrity, completeness, accuracy, and drive continuous improvement.    Participate in data governance processes to ensure data is properly maintained and document for reusability by the business    Understand data and metadata to support consistency of information retrieval, combination, analysis, pattern recognition and interpretation.      What you will bring    A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:     Understanding of Data Engineering concepts within a business setting, including working with multiple systems such as SAP, internal and external data sources. Experience in developing, enhancing, testing, and maintaining data products.    Experience in using diverse range of languages and tools, including scripting languages, for data extraction, transformation, storage, processing, and integration.    Analyze business requirements as a guide for data modeling and apply data analysis, design, modeling, and quality assurance techniques, continuous improvement, based on a detailed understanding of business processes, to establish, modify or maintain data structures and associated components (entity descriptions, relationship descriptions, attribute definitions).    Ability to simplify complex problems and effectively communicating technical concepts to a diverse audience.      More about this role      What extra ingredients will you bring:      Cloud computing technologies (Azure, GCP)    Programming Languages: SQL, Python, PySpark (Apache Spark), DAX, etc.    Analytics platforms: Databricks, Google Cloud Dataproc, etc.    Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, and DataOps techniques.    Experience with ETL, Data pipelines and architecture    Technical Documentation    Experience in data modelling and wrangling techniques and tools i.e., Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Data vault, Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, etc.    Data quality and profiling methods        Education / Certifications:      Bachelors degree in a related field. BS Computer Science, Information Systems, etc.      Job specific requirements:      1+ years Data Engineering/Modeling    3+ years Database Design      Work schedule:      Remote worker located in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Chicago, IL.

skills.source: Spotlight Call: Thursday, September 24th a 1pm est  Experience: Junior Developer  Location: US Virtual (Remote)    Job Description  We are seeking a Junior Developer to join the development team for one of our product lines. The product has built a hosted diagnostic imaging and telemedicine platform, custom built with current web technologies and tools, deployed on AWS in an agile Scrum environment. It gives our customers access to and collaboration on diagnostic radiology. You will work across our full stack .NET, Java, Python, React, and Angular alongside a closely-knit team of developers, designers, product managers, and QA testers. All candidates must have excellent communication skills, attention to detail, at least 3 years of relevant experience, and the ability to multitask in a deadline-oriented environment. The best fit will be a well-rounded individual with a desire to learn and grow, including learning to use AI tools like Claude to work more efficiently.    What will you do?  Design, code, test, debug, and document programs based on technical configurations developed by analysts and project teams. Estimate and track time required to complete work for project budgeting and financial tracking.  Develop program designs to meet technical configurations, ensuring resulting systems operate efficiently and reliably. Understand the business function supported by the application and ensure designs integrate with other related systems.  Code across our stack, using .NET, Java, Python, React, and Angular as appropriate to the task.  Test and debug programs to finalize and ensure smooth operation.  Document program design, coding, and other details to guide others in application development, use, and maintenance.  Support, update, and maintain existing systems in response to business needs, system problems, or other factors. Coordinate with project teams to design, code, test, and document system changes.  Coordinate with project team members to define application requirements. Identify business needs, assess available technologies, and develop and present solutions.  Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up coding, testing, debugging, and documentation, and share efficiency practices with the team.  Provide a high level of customer service, partnering with end users in the resolution of problems or in deployment of new applications.  Participate as an active member of a cross-functional Agile Scrum team.    What do you need to succeed?  At least 3 years of relevant software development experience.  Familiarity with the application development process.  Experience with, or strong interest in learning, .NET, Java, Python, React, and Angular.  Experience with HTML, JavaScript, and building web UIs.  Experience with, or willingness to learn, relational databases (Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server) and Structured Query Language (SQL).  Comfort using AI tools such as Claude to write, review, test, or document code more efficiently.  Excellent problem-solving skills.  Excellent customer service and business relationship building skills.  Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, including the ability to translate technical subject matter to non-technical audiences.  Ability to work independently and within a cross-functional Agile Scrum team.    Preferred Experience:  BA/BS in Computer Science (or related field) and/or equivalent work experience.  Experience handling raw image data or image files strongly preferred.  Familiarity with AWS.  Knowledge of system monitoring tools like AWS Console and Datadog.  Experience transforming business requirements into elegant designs and clean, unit-tested code.  Let's pursue what matters together!  *** values a diverse workforce and workplace and strongly encourages women, people of color, LGBT individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply. *** is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state, or federal laws.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

Business Justification:   FEP Local systems provides Machine Learning service to FEP Client plans to improve claim processing, provider prediction, and automation that reducing human intervention process. As extension of ML/AI service to other business cases and additional plans joined to this service, we need additional resources to help to development ML program with FEP Local development team.   Responsibility:     Develop algorithms, write scripts, build predictive analytics, use automation, apply machine learning, and use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn that set of disparate data points into objective answers to help senior leadership make informed decisions.   Provide the team with a deep understanding of their data, what it all means, and how they can use it.   Help with discovering the information hidden in vast amounts of data, and help with making smarter decisions to deliver even better products.   Applying data mining techniques, doing statistical analysis, and building high quality prediction systems integrated with products.   Development new ML model(s) as well as maintaining existing ones and their processes.   Development Gen AI solution using AI platform like AWS SageMaker, AWS Bedrock, AWS AgentCore.   Select features, building and optimizing classifiers using machine learning techniques, data mining using state-of-the-art methods, and, enhancing data collection procedures to include information that is relevant for building analytic systems.   Responsibilities will also include processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis and doing ad-hoc analysis and presenting results in a clear manner.   Creating automated anomaly detection systems and constant tracking of its performance.     Requirements:     Master's Degree or Ph.D. in STEM with 2 years preferred OR Bachelor’s Degree in STEM with 7 years.   Experience in predictive modeling, data science, machine learning, or user and entity behavior analytic development.   Experience in developing predictive, prescriptive, optimization, and forecasting models, including the use of contemporary techniques such as and not limited to support vector machines, neural networks, and gradient boosting.   Experience in developing of Generative AI solution with LLM and custom model to provide AI solution to business.   Experience in interpreting results from statistical and mathematical models.   A minimum of two years’ experience in applying Data Science/ Analytics to Health Insurance/Health Care related problems/use cases.   At least 1 years focused on applications of Generative AI solution.   Experience in programming languages like Java, Python and/or R for complex data manipulation, statistical analysis, and machine learning.   Experience in Analytic development with streaming and a Hadoop ecosystem (Hive, Spark, etc.)   Experience in SQL, NoSQL, graph-based, Key/Value stores, document stores.   Experience with cloud base data platform like Snowflake and use training/build model.   Experience with one or more cloud services (AWS SageMaker, MS Azure)   Experience applying machine learning to real-world production systems, analytic development based on SparkML and other ML libraries.   Experience in advanced data visualizations and interpretation using data visualization tools is plus (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).   Familiarity with common Linux/Unix command line tasks and version control software like git or svn preferable.   Using and developing statistical analysis, modeling, simulation, and machine learning methods.   Comfort with complex mathematical concepts and models.   Experience with Agile Methodology/Scrum Development and DevOps   History of solving difficult problems using a scientific approach highly preferred   Ability to communicate and present the work effectively and influence others   Ability to work in a fast paced environment and shift gears quickly         Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.
