skills.source: Position Details:   Title:  Software Engineer 3 / Software Engineer 4   Location:  500 McCullough Ave, San Antonio, TX 78215   Duration:  12+ Months   Pay Rate:  Open to negotiate on W2   Job ID:  26-28282  Only USC/GC   Position Summary:  Designs, develops, tests, and maintains software programs based on customer requirements, using development standards and software development lifecycle process. Daily tasks may include requirements analysis, design, planning, programming, testing, documentation, error/exception handling, performance improvements and business process implementation. Tasks may also include analysis, research and recommendations for process implementation, performance and technology improvements. Demonstrates technical expertise through maintaining primary technical programming skills for assigned job, developing new skills as required, developing guidelines and standards, and demonstrating best practices and leadership.     Tasks and Responsibilities:     Designs, develops, tests, and maintains software solutions to meet customer requirements. Tasks required to complete this often include requirements analysis, documentation, error/exception handling, business process implementation, performance analysis/improvements and technology research.   Maintain technical skills through hands-on experience, independent research, training and/or conferences.   Strong understanding of secure cloud technologies.   Collaborates with leadership, product owners, architects, and business liaison to understand requirements.   Maintains and enhances existing system design through strong understanding of architecture and test-driven development skills.   Research and develop new technologies to enhance current and future design, security and system performance.   Strong understanding of Web Services and SOAP/REST integrations of third-party and remote systems.     Expert knowledge in optimizing SQL relational operations including direct query, caching mechanisms, read/write clustering, etc.   Strong understanding of DevOps best practices, Code Repository Branching/Merging, and system integrations.   Expert knowledge of code implementation, and upgrades of platform infrastructures.   Good understanding of the configuration and management of Apache Tomcat for hosting Java Web Applications.   Knowledge of SSL and Encryption methodologies, as well as an understanding of SSL implementations.   Good understanding of secure cloud technologies.   Ability to assist in the communication with customers, requirements gathering, design, analysis, documentation, and development of project assignments.   Technical skills necessary for developing architectural designs from gathered requirements.     Ability to develop full-stack application solutions.   Self-managed and motivated to maintain project deliverables and timelines.   Technical knowledge to identify gaps and complications in project designs.   Ability to professionally negotiate and challenge decisions, when necessary, to ensure project success.   Participate in Agile development methodology and ceremonies.   Performs other duties as assigned.      Minimum Qualifications:     Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering from an accredited university OR Relevant technical programming experience.   Mid-level experience in web-based IT solutions.   Demonstrates at least two or more primary technical skill area listed here: Java and/or web programming, including JSP, Servlets, JDBC, web services, mobile, Angular, React, React Native, VueJS, JSON and HTML web development, Relational database design and application development (i.e., Oracle, DB2, etc.), including SQL queries, PL/SQL, Oracle APEX, DB2, etc., and Hands-on developer application server experience, including Apache Tomcat, WebSphere Application Server or other (preferred).   Proficient in using GitHub, including branching and merging.   Demonstrated ability to create and execute unit tests.   Object-oriented programming experience.   Mid-level experience with one or more development methodologies (i.e., waterfall, Agile, Rational Unified Process – RUP, etc.).   Demonstrates critical thinking problem solving skills on a semi-routing basis for creative and innovative solutions.   Demonstrates decision-making and communication skills to address customer issues, as well as analyze and clarify a new project assignment.   Ability to work well in a team environment.   Demonstrates technical writing skills.   Demonstrates customer service and situation-appropriate, professional customer communication.   Demonstrates time management and multi-tasking skills.   Independent thinking skills and ability to self-manage workload. Responsibilities are usually project oriented with general guidelines and references available.   Ability to work independently on project assignments, including communication with customers, requirements gathering, design, analysis, documentation, and development.   Understanding of APIs and modern technology architecture.      Preferred Qualifications:     Java Developer Certification(s).   Oracle or DB2 Certification(s).   Experience with Oracle AEM integrations.   Experience with Oracle Visual Builder.   Professional Experience in web-based IT solutions.   Experience in mobile responsive Web design.   Solid knowledge of OWASP and familiarity with web application vulnerabilities.   Demonstrates technical writing skills.   Demonstrates customer service and situation-appropriate, professional customer communication.   Demonstrates time management and multi-tasking skills.   Experience with CI/CD pipeline configurations and management.   Working knowledge of source control software (SVN or Git), build and deployment tools (Maven, Jenkins, Gradle).   Sharp troubleshooting skills and real-world systems deployment experience.      Working Conditions:     Environment  - Indoor work, operating computer, manual dexterity, talking, hearing, repetitive motion. Use of personal computing equipment, telephone, multi-functioning printer, and calculator. Ability to travel to and from meetings, training sessions, or other business-related events.   Physical Demands  - Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.     Regards,   Alisha Keshri   Associate Recruiter   Artech Information System LLC   360Mt. Kemble Ave., suite 2000   Morristown, NJ 07960   Email:  Alisha.Keshri@artech.com ,  Website:  www.artech.com

About the Role:     We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist with expertise in simulation modeling, probability theory, and Python programming.         This role focuses on designing and deploying simulation frameworks to evaluate and optimize enterprise solutions. Ideal candidates will have experience in inventory models, stochastic processes, and building scalable simulation systems.         Key Responsibilities:     Design, develop, and deploy simulation models for inventory and operational systems using Python, SQL, and PySpark on platforms like Databricks.   Apply probability theory and Monte Carlo methods to model uncertainty and variability.   Collaborate with Data Engineers and Data Scientists to define simulation inputs and integrate pipelines.   Implement CI/CD principles and manage code repositories using GitHub Enterprise.   Validate and calibrate simulation models using historical data and sensitivity analysis.   Ensure code quality, scalability, and maintainability in production environments.     Required Qualifications:     Hands-on experience with simulation modeling and inventory systems.   Proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark.   Strong understanding of probability theory, stochastic modeling, and Monte Carlo simulation.   Experience with Databricks or similar enterprise cloud environments.   Familiarity with CI/CD principles and GitHub Enterprise.   Self-starter with an ownership mindset and ability to work independently.     Preferred Qualifications:     Experience in retail, supply chain, or operations research.   Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).             Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

This role will develop, automate, validate, and maintain operational metrics and reporting across dispensing data sources while ensuring compliance with HIPAA, protected health information requirements, and covered-entity data-governance policies.   Core Responsibilities     Recreate, validate, maintain, and improve operational metrics using platform usage and pharmacy fulfillment data.   Improve the automation, accuracy, availability, and quality of dispensing and operational data.   Create and deploy operational dashboards for use within the covered entity.   Track and report performance metrics and provide timely, accurate updates to reporting tools.   Develop consolidated reporting views across dispensing data sources to support filtering, grouping, and finance reporting.   Conduct operational performance analysis using SQL and Excel.   Identify trends, operational issues, and improvement opportunities within pharmacy dispensing and fulfillment data.   Translate data findings into clear, actionable insights for internal stakeholders.   Support urgent operational issues through data-driven analysis and cross-functional problem-solving.   Contribute to KPI definitions, reporting standards, and data-strategy documentation.   Handle PHI and other sensitive data according to HIPAA, covered-entity policies, and established data-governance requirements.   Maintain appropriate separation between manufacturer and covered-entity data, including partner-level and patient-level information.     Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies     Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, healthcare administration, data science, or a related discipline.   Proficiency in SQL and Excel.   Proficiency in at least one statistical programming language: Python or R.   Familiarity with healthcare, pharmacy, claims, or dispensing operational data.   1–3 years of work experience within a HIPAA covered entity.   Experience developing, validating, or maintaining operational metrics and reporting.   Understanding of HIPAA, PHI handling, data privacy, and covered-entity compliance requirements.   Ability to complete and maintain required data privacy, HIPAA, and covered-entity compliance training.   Ability to handle protected health information according to established policies.     Preferred Skills or Experience     Experience creating operational dashboards, KPI reporting, or cross-source analytical views.   Experience improving reporting automation, data accuracy, or data-quality validation.   Understanding of pharmacy dispensing and fulfillment operations.   Experience documenting KPIs, reporting processes, or data strategies.   Understanding of manufacturer and covered-entity data-separation requirements.   Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and business acumen.   Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly to internal stakeholders.   Experience working across business, operations, analytics, and compliance teams. Primary responsibilities include developing monitoring solutions, troubleshooting/debugging and implementing the fix for internally developed code (Perl, C/C++, JAVA), performing SQL queries, improving our systems that gather metrics on our features, updating, tracking and resolving technical challenges. Responsibilities also include working alongside development on Amazon Corporate and Divisional Software projects, updating/enhancing our current software, automation of support processes and documentation of our systems. Job Qualifications:The ideal candidate is interested in a career in software development and is looking to utilize and expand their coding skills and gain exposure to a wide variety of software applications. They must be detail oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, are able to work independently and can maintain professionalism under pressure. Preferred coding skills: Perl, C/C++ and/or Java. Other desired technical skills include Mason, Perl CGI, Oracle SQL, HTML, UNIX/LINUX. A Computer Science or equivalent technical degree and 2-5 years of relevant experience is required.

lost.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.   Job Title: AI Engineer   Job Location:   Mclean, VA   Job Summary:   We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer to support the rollout, integration, and operationalization of Claude Code across engineering teams. The role focuses on enabling Large Language Model (LLM)–based development workflows using AWS Bedrock, ensuring scalable deployment on Kubernetes, and providing ongoing technical support and optimization. This position plays a critical role in driving enterprise adoption of Generative AI tools while ensuring reliability, security, and developer productivity.     Key Responsibilities:     Support the rollout and adoption of Claude Code across engineering teams.   Design, integrate, and operate LLM-powered workflows using AWS Bedrock.   Develop backend services and automation using GoLang.   Deploy, manage, and scale GenAI services on Kubernetes.   Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting for GenAI-related issues.   Collaborate with DevOps, Platform, and Security teams to ensure compliant and efficient deployments.   Monitor performance, usage, and cost of LLM workloads; optimize where necessary.   Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and best practices.   Stay updated with advancements in GenAI, LLMs, and AWS AI services.           Required Skills & Qualifications:     Strong experience with AWS, including IAM, networking, and observability.   Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock and managed LLM services.   Solid understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and GenAI use cases.   Proficiency in GoLang for backend development and tooling.   Strong experience with Kubernetes (deployment, scaling, troubleshooting).   Experience supporting or running GenAI/ML platforms in production.   Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native architectures.             Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

lost.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Software Dev Engineer I   Location(s):  Sunnyvale, CA       Job Description:  The Agentic AI and Applied Foundation Model team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to improve the reliability, maintainability, and testability of complex robotic systems. You will build tools and infrastructure that help engineers diagnose failures, automate operational workflows, reproduce software environments, and understand exactly which software, models, firmware, configurations, and assets were used in each robot test.   This role sits at the intersection of robotics, developer infrastructure, automation, and machine learning systems. You will work with hardware, firmware, simulation, and applied ML teams to turn fragmented operational knowledge and manual processes into dependable software systems.   The ideal candidate is comfortable working across system boundaries, investigating ambiguous failures, and delivering practical tools that make other engineers more effective.   Key Responsibilities:     Develop tools for diagnosing, maintaining, and upgrading robotic systems.   Convert operational knowledge—such as troubleshooting sessions, runbooks, logs, and incident history—into structured, searchable, and context-aware support systems.   Build automation for operational workflows, including issue triage, ownership resolution, notifications, approvals, remediation, and escalation.   Design systems that safely automate actions on production or lab infrastructure while maintaining appropriate human review and auditability.   Build and maintain a registry of robots, test runs, software artifacts, machine-learning models, firmware versions, calibration data, configurations, and simulation assets.   Establish traceability between test inputs and results so experiments can be reproduced, compared, and audited.   Identify configuration and asset drift across development, simulation, and physical systems.   Create automated verification and regression-testing workflows for robotics software and infrastructure changes.   Reproduce robot software stacks in development or lab environments to support debugging, migration, and system-level testing.   Assist with separating software workloads from robot hardware and validating changes across different compute environments.   Support the testing and performance evaluation of optimized machine-learning inference paths.   Improve system observability through logging, metrics, dashboards, alerts, and diagnostic tooling.   Participate in design reviews, incident response, operational support, and continuous improvement of engineering processes.   Produce clear documentation and share technical knowledge across teams.     Basic Qualifications:     Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.   Software development experience using Python and C++.   Knowledge of object-oriented programming.   Experience designing, implementing, testing, and operating production-quality software.   Experience with Linux systems, command-line tooling, networking fundamentals, and debugging distributed or multi-component systems.   Experience building automation, internal developer tools, backend services, or systems integrations.   Familiarity with APIs, structured data, databases, and event-driven or workflow-based systems.   Ability to investigate ambiguous technical problems and turn manual processes into maintainable software solutions.   Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across hardware and software disciplines.     Preferred Qualifications:     Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, embedded systems, or hardware-in-the-loop development.   Experience with CI/CD, test infrastructure, artifact management, configuration management, or experiment-tracking systems.   Familiarity with cloud storage and compute services, containers, and infrastructure-as-code.   Experience with machine-learning model deployment, inference runtimes, GPU acceleration, or performance benchmarking.   Familiarity with simulation environments, digital assets, calibration workflows, or robot fleet management.   Experience building retrieval, search, or AI-assisted knowledge systems using documentation, runbooks, logs, and other operational data.   Experience developing safe automation for production systems, including approval workflows, access controls, audit trails, and rollback mechanisms.   Understanding of software and data provenance, reproducibility, versioning, and dependency management.   Experience improving observability and responding to operational incidents.       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

This includes the      Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) and related public disclosures, the Net Stable      Funding Ratio (NSFR), and the FR 2052a Complex Institution Liquidity      Monitoring Report. The team also develops tools to help our business      partners analyze the impact of business decisions. In addition, we      collaborate with internal and external partners on ongoing examinations      and audits of liquidity practices. As a Regulatory Reporting Analyst,      you will support the daily production, validation, control, and submission      processes for U.S. liquidity regulatory reporting. You will take primary      responsibility for FR 2052a reporting while providing additional support      for the LCR and NSFR reporting processes. This role requires strong      analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently      manage daily production activities within strict regulatory deadlines      while partnering cross-functionally with Treasury, Finance, Risk, Data,      and Technology teams.         Responsibilities    Execute daily FR 2052a production, validation, and      regulatory submission activities in accordance with established procedures      and strict reporting deadlines. Perform detailed variance analysis, reconciliations,      and quality reviews to ensure reporting completeness, accuracy, and      compliance. Utilize SQL to analyze large datasets, investigate      reporting anomalies, and identify root causes of data issues. Monitor reporting processes, data feeds, and system      interfaces; promptly identify, escalate, and track issues to ensure timely      and effective resolution. Support LCR and NSFR reporting processes, including      data validation, reconciliations, and reporting controls. Partner with Treasury, Finance, Risk, Data Management,      and Technology teams to resolve data discrepancies and implement reporting      enhancements. Maintain and enhance reporting procedures, control      documentation, governance evidence, and audit support materials. Participate in testing, implementation, and production      validation of regulatory reporting changes, system upgrades, and new      initiatives. Identify and implement automation opportunities to      improve reporting efficiency, reduce manual processes, and strengthen      operational controls. Develop comprehensive business requirements for      functional and nonfunctional enhancements supporting liquidity regulatory      reporting processes. Create and optimize SQL queries to analyze datasets of      varying complexity, develop analytical models, and interpret data from      multiple sources (databases, spreadsheets, and reporting systems).         Minimum Qualifications    Bachelor's degree. 2-5 years of related experience within a financial      institution (e.g., banking or broker-dealer businesses). Experience with liquidity regulatory reporting,      specifically FR 2052a, Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), and Net Stable      Funding Ratio (NSFR). Experience working with SQL and Microsoft Excel to      analyze large datasets and run complex queries. Basic knowledge of finance and accounting principles.         Preferred Qualifications    Experience with AxiomSL ControllerView. Knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accounting policy. Hands-on experience implementing automation tools to      optimize reporting processes. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a      proven track record in data analysis and trend identification. Excellent documentation skills, with the ability to      create comprehensive business requirements, process documentation, and      analytical reports. Ability to navigate ambiguity, make informed decisions,      and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities.    Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.

Work involves highly advanced (senior-level) systems administration in support of agency mainframe applications and supporting infrastructure; and coordinate day-to-day system administration functions such as mainframe configuration, break/fix system support, and base user account creation/support.   Routine system administration functions to include security administration support, performance monitoring, security monitoring, and system maintenance.   Work includes supporting data entry and control work processes, overseeing and coordinating mainframe operations in the State’s Consolidated Data Center Services (DCS), and working with the Network Administration, Customer Support and Applications Development & Support teams to provide support necessary for day-to-day mainframe operations.   Experience with Informatica Power Exchange Administration for Change Data Capture processing using mainframe data sources and targets (i.e., IMS and VSAM) a plus.     The Worker will apply their expert knowledge and experience as a Mainframe z/OS Systems Programmer to support both the needs of the Legacy Systems as well as those for the Mainframe Transformation Team.     Worker Skills and Qualifications:     Provide primary support as the subject matter expert for z/OS operating systems and system components; provide direct technical support as needed in the planning, implementation and testing of releases, upgrades, or changes to z/OS operating system, network, and component software.   Provide end user support for assigned Independent Software Vendor (ISV) products such as Blue Zone.   Provide primary administration and end user support for SCLM.   Provide input and recommendations for hardware capacity planning.   Provide primary administrative support for CICS® and IMS™.   Diagnose platform, software, and related product issues and follow up with root cause analysis.   Analyze performance issues and provide input and recommendations for capacity planning.   Provide input and recommendations for system-wide performance tuning to meet required levels of service.   Provide input and recommendations for system parameters and system libraries management.   Provide support for technical consultation and inquiries from the other IT technical teams.   Provide support as technical lead on internal team projects or participate on project teams that impact the z/OS platform.   Provide support for Integration-testing new products with existing applications and user procedures.   Assist with maintaining and providing technical support for Mainframe Production Control and Support Jobs and monthly Mainframe Job Scheduler.     II. CANDIDATE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS   Minimum Requirements:     5 Years Required: Experience with z/OS Systems Programming.   5 Years Required: Experience with JES2, z/OS Unix System Services (OMVS), Storage Management Subsystem (SMS).   3 Years Required: Experience with TSS (Top Secret Security).   3 Years Required: Experience with performance monitoring to include initial analysis of performance issues.   2 Years Required: Experience with REXX.   3 Years Preferred: Experience with Informatica Power Exchange Administration.   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: z/OS Operation, z/OS Networking – VTAM (Virtual Telecommunications Access Method), TCP/IP (Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol).   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: z/OS-centric automated job scheduling and management software (JOBTRAC), Terminal Emulator Software (BLUEZONE), VTAM Session Manager Software (VTAM/SWITCH).   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: SMP/E (System Modification Program/Extended), RMF (Resource Measurement Facility), SMF (System Management Facility), WLM (Workload Management), JCL (Job Control Language).   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: GRS (Global Resource Serialization), VSAM (Virtual Storage Access Method), TSO (Time Sharing Option).   3 Years Preferred: Experience with TLS configuration (certificates, SSL – RSA Keys, SFTP, FTPS).   3 Years Preferred: Experience with SCLM (or other similar configuration management .tools), specifically configuration and administration of SCLM.   3 Years Preferred: Experience with CPM for JOBTRAC.           Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans, or individuals with disabilities.

Works closely with other IT and business partners to deliver NSA, MARVEL and OMNI deliverables.  Manages computer systems in a business environment and is responsible for resolving technical issues.  Knowledgeable in programming, data structures, computer systems, and software engineering.  Ensures system reliability and scalability. Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or other related field. Ability to manage multiple assignments.  Superior written and oral communication skills. Delivering an integrated roadmap on the maintenance and development of the NSA platform. Collaborating with GTS and business stakeholders to implement business requirements.  Working closely with business owners and other subject matter experts on requirements gathering and design. I mplementing Agile practices on all project/development work. Ensuring system reliability, scalability and conformance to best security practices.  Working on the development and delivery of high quality tested code working closely with a team of other developers across multiple locations and time zones.  Driving the consolidation of tools and automation of performance results and data.  Working closely with the Quality Assurance team to ensure code quality and working on timely delivery of fixes for any defects.  Being responsible and accountable for the details of end to end system flows, architecture and development of complex ecommerce systems supporting sales and service flows and transactions.  Finding creative solutions, making timely decisions, developing, providing LOE?s, supervising junior members and keeping the project on track.  Lead medium to large size projects using both offshore and onshore resources and providing guidance to junior staff members. Working with offshore development resources from the VZI Team.  Working with internal teams and Vendors on providing technical direction on solutions for various interfaces and API?s for both internal and external systems.  Leading a development team and is a technical SME for the ecommerce system. Knowledge of Spring boot framework and its various modules.  Experience with REST services with various methods like GET, POST, PUT using JSON structures.  Experience with setting up, configuring, and managing API proxies to enhance API functionality, security, and performance. Knowledge of service oriented multi-tier applications.  Knowledge of products and services. What we're looking for? You'll need to have: Bachelor?s degree or four or more years of work experience.  Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. Experience in Java 8 reactive programming.  Experience with PNO layer and Cassandra DB. Experience in Microservices, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes containerization, EKS, Spring boot framework for systems Integration, Tomcat or Netty and GraphQL.  Experience in DevOps Tools - GIT, Jenkins. JIRA, Ansible, Test Driven development (e.g., JUnit, Selenium, Sonar, Kibana, Grafana). Experience in designing, developing, and troubleshooting API proxies.

skills.label: C++
skills.source: Overview  Client is seeking a Software Engineer to support embedded software development for equipment control systems. This role focuses on developing and integrating software solutions for embedded hardware using C/C++, with an emphasis on controls logic and human-machine interfaces.  You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to develop, test, and deliver secure, high-quality embedded software solutions throughout the software development lifecycle.     Core Responsibilities  • Design and implement secure, high-quality embedded software solutions for equipment controls.  • Collaborate with software, firmware, controls, hardware, and applications teams to ensure effective subsystem integration.  • Support the full software development lifecycle, including requirements, design documentation, prototyping, implementation, and unit testing.  • Deliver secure, high-quality software products in a timely manner.  • Contribute to a collaborative engineering environment and support continuous improvement initiatives.     Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on embedded software development experience; recent graduates with successful internship or co-op experience are encouraged to apply.  • Strong software design and programming skills using C/C++.  • Experience with development tools such as Git and Jira.  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with excellent attention to detail.  • Ability to work on-site in New Freedom, Pennsylvania.     Work Details  • On-site role located in New Freedom, PA.     Nesco Resource provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

skills.label: C#
skills.source: Overview  Client is seeking a Measurement Systems Software Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and deployment of software for industrial measurement and inspection systems used in manufacturing environments. This role focuses on C#/.NET software development, hardware integration, and the delivery of reliable, production-ready measurement solutions.  The engineer will work with distributed software applications that coordinate imaging, motion, I/O, sequencing, and data handling for product inspection and quality control. The role also includes evaluating and applying AI-assisted software development practices to improve engineering workflows and productivity.     Core Responsibilities  • Design, develop, test, maintain, and support software for industrial measurement and machine vision systems using C#/.NET.  • Develop and support distributed measurement system applications, including software communication, coordination, configuration, and data handling.  • Support software build, release, deployment, system integration, and technology transfer activities from development into manufacturing.  • Evaluate, adopt, and apply AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering efficiency.  • Contribute to best practices for incorporating AI development tools into day-to-day software engineering activities.  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including software specifications and support documentation.  • Train engineering, maintenance, and operations personnel on the use, support, and maintenance of deployed systems.  • Provide remote and onsite troubleshooting for software and integrated measurement systems.     Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies  • BS, MS, or PhD preferred in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.  • Experience developing software applications in C#/.NET for production use, system integration, or industrial applications.  • Experience designing, developing, and troubleshooting software for distributed, multi-process, or integrated systems.  • Familiarity with software communication and messaging methods such as publish/subscribe architectures, message queues, or similar approaches.  • Experience with source control, software versioning, and build/release workflows using tools such as Git, GitLab, automated build systems, and package management tools.  • Experience supporting software deployment, troubleshooting, and long-term support in development or manufacturing environments.  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.  • Interest in applying AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering productivity.     Preferred Skills or Experience  • Experience with WPF user interface development frameworks in .NET.  • Experience with motion control systems, cameras, image acquisition hardware, and integrated imaging platforms.  • Hands-on experience working with imaging hardware, cameras, measurement equipment, or related instrumentation.  • Experience applying machine learning or computer vision methods to inspection, classification, or measurement problems.  • Familiarity with databases, containerization, or high-performance computing environments.  • Experience evaluating, adopting, or helping define best practices for AI-enabled software development workflows.  • Knowledge of machine vision and image processing methods such as feature extraction, edge detection, morphology, classification, inspection, and metrology.  • Experience with machine vision or image processing libraries such as Halcon, OpenCV, LabVIEW, or similar tools.     Work Details  • 40 hours per week with a flexible schedule as needed.  • Up to 10% to 30% domestic and international travel may be required, with trips ranging from one day to several weeks.  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.    Nesco Resource offers a comprehensive benefits package for our associates, which includes a MEC (Minimum Essential Coverage) plan that encompasses Medical, Vision, Dental, 401K, and EAP (Employee Assistance Program) services.     Nesco Resource provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This role combines traditional software quality engineering with emerging AI validation techniques to ensure AI systems are reliable, safe, accurate, performant, and production-ready.  The ideal candidate has a strong software testing background, experience building automated test frameworks, and an interest in AI technologies such as LLMs, agents, RAG systems, MCP integrations, and machine learning models. The ideal candidate will have a strong software engineering background combined with  DevSecOps, CI/CD, cloud-native development, containerization, and Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL)  experience. This individual will play a key role in strengthening software supply chain security and promoting secure development practices throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).   Experience within the  Banking, Capital Markets, or Cybersecurity  domains is highly preferred.   Key Responsibilities   Software Engineering       Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable enterprise-grade software applications using  Go, Java, JavaScript, and Python .       Develop secure, cloud-native applications using modern software engineering practices.       Design and implement  microservices, distributed systems, APIs, and scalable application architectures .       Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to architecture and technology decisions.       Conduct and participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, performance, and security.       Evaluate and integrate appropriate open-source technologies and frameworks.       Troubleshoot complex application and production issues and implement sustainable solutions.       DevSecOps & CI/CD       Design, implement, and optimize  CI/CD pipelines  using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab.       Integrate automated security testing and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines.       Implement automated  code scanning, vulnerability scanning, dependency analysis, and security testing .       Develop automation to support continuous integration, testing, deployment, and secure software releases.       Promote and implement

skills.label: Java
skills.source: Dev10 is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineering Instructor (Java) for a Remote position. This is an 8+ month contract-to-hire opportunity.   This position is ideal for a software developer who enjoys teaching, mentoring, and helping others launch successful careers in technology. The successful candidate will guide Associates through an intensive software engineering training program focused on Java, full-stack development, databases, APIs, testing, and modern software engineering practices. In addition to delivering instruction and providing technical coaching, the Instructor will collaborate with fellow instructors to continuously improve curriculum and ensure students are prepared to meet the evolving needs of clients and the technology industry.   Responsibilities:     Participate in training activities daily during core hours of 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM CT   Deliver technical instruction, demonstrations, workshops, and Q&A sessions   Create an engaging and supportive learning environment that promotes student success   Monitor student progress and provide coaching to help Associates achieve learning objectives   Support and troubleshoot student challenges during labs, exercises, and project work   Foster confidence, accountability, and problem-solving skills among Associates   Conduct weekly code reviews and provide detailed, constructive feedback   Evaluate technical assignments against established standards and best practices   Meet one-on-one with Associates who need additional support or guidance   Collaborate with the instructional team to continuously improve curriculum and training materials   Support technical evaluations used during the recruiting process   Mentor new instructors as they develop classroom management and instructional skills     Requirements:     3+ years of professional software development experience   Strong understanding of full-stack software engineering principles and practices   Passion for mentoring, coaching, and developing technical talent   Excellent verbal and written communication skills   Ability to explain technical concepts to individuals with varying levels of experience   Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills   Java   Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)   SQL and Relational Databases   APIs and Web Services   HTML   CSS   Git and Version Control   Command Line/Terminal Fundamentals   Test-Driven Development (TDD)   Software Testing Principles   Web Security and Authentication   Software Design and Development Best Practices     Desired skills:     Previous experience as a technical instructor, trainer, educator, teaching assistant, or mentor   Experience leading technical workshops, bootcamps, or training programs   Experience reviewing and providing feedback on code   Background in full-stack web application development   Experience coaching junior developers or early-career technology professionals   Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS   Exposure to AI-assisted development tools, Generative AI, or Agentic application development   Curriculum development or instructional design experience     Pay range: $110,000 - $150,000 annually   Only candidates available and ready to work directly as Genesis10 employees will be considered for this position.   If you have the described qualifications and are interested in this exciting opportunity, please apply!   Benefits of Working with Genesis10 / Dev10:     Medical, Dental, Vision   Health Savings Account   Voluntary Hospital Indemnity (Critical Illness & Accident)   Voluntary Term Life Insurance   401K   Sick Pay (for applicable states/municipalities)   Commuter Benefits (Dallas, NYC, SF, and Illinois)   Fun & flexible team environment     Genesis10 is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Job Description:	 Ansible Playbooks & Roles: Writing idempotent playbooks, structuring roles for reusability, managing dependencies. YAML & Jinja2: Deep understanding of YAML syntax, Jinja2 templating, filters, and conditionals for dynamic configuration. Inventory Management: Building dynamic and static inventories, grouping, host variables, and integration with external sources Linux Administration: Strong proficiency with common distributions (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian, Alpine), package management, systemd, networking config, and security hardening. Windows Support: Ansible Windows modules, PowerShell remediation, and Active Directory integration (if applicable). Infrastructure Abstraction: Combining Ansible with Terraform or CloudFormation for hybrid approaches or using Ansible alone for configuration post-provisioning. Container & Kubernetes: Ansible for cluster bootstrapping, pod/ deployment management, and container runtime configuration. Version Control: Git workflows for playbook/role repositories, branching strategies, and pull-request-based reviews. CI/CD Integration: Embedding Ansible runs in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure Pipelines for automated testing, linting (ansible-lint), and deployment. Testing & Validation: Using Molecule for role testing, TestInfra for server validation, and integration with schema/ policy checks. Secrets Management: Integrating with HashiCorp Vault, Ansible Vault, or cloud KMS for secure handling of passwords, API keys, and TLS certificates. Compliance & Auditing: Ensuring playbooks meet organizational security standards, generating compliance reports, and maintaining audit trails. Networking Basics: DNS, DHCP, VPCs/subnets, load balancers, firewalls, and IP address management. Other IaC Tools: Familiarity with Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation helps when designing hybrid or multi-cloud strategies. Observability: Wiring Ansible outputs into monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk) for drift detection and operational visibility. Scripting & Automation: Python or Bash for custom modules, hooks, or glue code between Ansible and other tooling.  			  			 Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.label: Power BI
skills.source: A major client of ours has a need for a Data Analyst/Scientist. This is a long-term contract (Potentially 2 years) and the position is remote but EST/CST is preferred.   Position Overview   We are seeking a  Data Analyst/Scientist  to support a Customer Analytics and Digital Products team within a large utility organization. This role will analyze large-scale utility and customer datasets, identify trends and data quality issues, develop dashboards and reporting, and provide actionable insights that support customer-facing digital products and business initiatives.   The ideal candidate has meaningful  utility industry and AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure) data experience , strong analytical and data validation skills, and the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear business recommendations.   Key Responsibilities     Analyze large utility datasets, including  AMI usage, Customer Care & Billing (CC&B), and customer engagement data .   Review and validate data extracts, vendor dashboards, and multi-source datasets for  data quality issues, anomalies, trends, and common themes .   Develop and maintain  Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations, and recurring reporting  to track key business and customer metrics.   Analyze customer engagement, product performance, billing outcomes, and other key performance indicators.   Support customer-facing digital products, including  rate recommendation and bill comparison tools , using historical usage and billing data.   Track and analyze website and digital product engagement, including page views, clicks, and customer interactions.   Partner with  Product Owners, engineers, business SMEs, and other stakeholders  to support data integrations, testing, validation, and product enhancements.   Investigate data discrepancies and anomalies and help identify root causes and potential solutions.   Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for both technical and business stakeholders.   Manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail in a regulated utility environment.     Required Qualifications & Critical Skills     2+ years of professional data analysis experience , including experience analyzing large data extracts or datasets.   Hands-on utility industry and AMI data experience is required.  Candidates without meaningful utility and AMI experience should not be submitted.   Fundamental understanding of  utility customer usage data  and related business processes.   Strong experience identifying  trends, anomalies, common themes, and data quality issues  within large datasets.   Hands-on experience with  Power BI  for dashboards, reporting, and data visualization.   Experience working with  large, multi-source datasets , including Databricks or comparable data platforms.   Strong data validation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.   Excellent attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a regulated environment.   Strong written and verbal communication skills.   Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders and translate technical findings into clear business recommendations.   Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a project-focused environment.   Bachelor’s degree required.     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with  Customer Care & Billing (CC&B)  data and tools.   Experience with  Google Analytics  or similar digital engagement analytics platforms.   Experience analyzing website and digital product engagement, including page views, clicks, and customer interactions.   Experience developing dashboards, recurring reports, data visualizations, and analytics supporting  customer-facing digital products .   Experience supporting data integrations, testing, validation, and product improvement initiatives within a utility environment.     Technology Requirements   Must Have     AMI / Advanced Metering Infrastructure data   Utility usage data   Power BI   Databricks and/or experience working with large, multi-source datasets     Nice to Have     Customer Care & Billing (CC&B)   Google Analytics   Digital engagement analytics   Customer-facing digital product analytics   Dashboard and visualization development     Success in This Role   Success in this role will be demonstrated by the ability to:     Deliver accurate, actionable analysis of complex utility and customer datasets.   Identify and communicate meaningful trends, anomalies, and data quality issues.   Develop clear dashboards and visualizations that enable stakeholders to understand key metrics.   Support reliable data integrations, testing, and validation for customer-facing digital products.   Collaborate effectively with Product Owners, engineers, and business stakeholders.   Turn complex data findings into practical recommendations that improve products, processes, and customer experiences. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere.        location: Austin, Texas   job type: Permanent   salary: $120,000 - 150,000  per year   work hours: 9am to 5pm   education: Bachelors       responsibilities:   Key Responsibilities  Build and maintain:  Develop the services and partner integrations that power reliable USD and CAD money movement. Feature ownership:  Take end-to-end ownership of specific features and components, from understanding the problem through delivery, rollout, and long-term operation. Quality delivery:  Write maintainable, well-tested code while ensuring predictable delivery and effective observability. Team contribution:  Participate actively in code reviews, share technical knowledge, and collaborate closely with your peers to reduce knowledge silos. Product alignment:  Apply a strong product mindset to connect your daily engineering tasks to customer outcomes, payout speed, and system quality.         qualifications:   Requirements  Core stack: Solid experience building backend systems with Java or Kotlin, Spring Boot, microservices, relational databases, and well-designed APIs.  System knowledge: A working understanding of distributed systems principles, including asynchronous processing, data consistency, and failure recovery.  Working style: A self-starting and collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently on defined features and ask the right questions when blocked.  Communication: Clear communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical concepts effectively with team members and cross-functional partners.  Bonus skills: Experience with Kafka, event-driven architecture, or cloud infrastructure is highly valued, though not strictly required.      skills:   Kafka,APIs,backend,cloud infrastructure,code reviews,CAD,distributed systems,event-driven architecture,Java,Kotlin,microservices,relational databases,Spring Boot,Communication,self-starting,ability to work independently,collaborative,data consistency,product mindset,Clear communication,system quality,technical knowledge      Equal Opportunity Employer: Race, Color, Religion, Sex, Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity, National Origin, Age, Genetic Information, Disability, Protected Veteran Status, or any other legally protected group status. skills.label: Python
skills.source: Dev10 is seeking a Full Stack Data Engineering Instructor for a Remote position. This is an 8+ month contract-to-hire opportunity.   This position is ideal for an experienced data professional who enjoys teaching, mentoring, and helping others launch successful careers in technology. The successful candidate will guide Associates through an intensive data engineering training program focused on data pipelines, cloud data platforms, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT processes, big data technologies, data modeling, and modern data engineering practices. In addition to delivering instruction and providing technical coaching, the Instructor will collaborate with fellow instructors to continuously improve curriculum and ensure Associates are prepared to meet the evolving needs of enterprise clients in a data-driven world.   Responsibilities:     Participate in training activities daily during core hours of 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM CT   Deliver technical instruction, demonstrations, hands-on workshops, and Q&A sessions focused on data engineering concepts and technologies   Create an engaging and supportive learning environment that promotes student success   Monitor Associate progress and provide coaching to help learners achieve technical and professional development objectives   Support and troubleshoot student challenges during labs, exercises, and project work   Foster confidence, accountability, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills among Associates   Conduct weekly reviews of data engineering projects, pipelines, and code, providing detailed and constructive feedback   Evaluate technical assignments against industry standards, best practices, and client expectations   Meet one-on-one with Associates who need additional support or guidance   Collaborate with the instructional team to continuously improve curriculum, labs, and training materials   Support technical evaluations and assessments used during the recruiting process   Mentor new instructors as they develop classroom management and instructional skills   Stay current on emerging data engineering technologies, cloud platforms, and industry trends     Requirements:     3+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics Engineering, Software Engineering with a strong data focus, or related disciplines   Strong understanding of data engineering principles, architectures, and best practices   Passion for mentoring, coaching, and developing technical talent   Excellent verbal and written communication skills   Ability to explain technical concepts to individuals with varying levels of experience   Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills   Python   SQL and Relational Databases   Data Modeling and Database Design   ETL/ELT Development   Data Warehousing Concepts   Data Integration and Data Movement Techniques   Apache Spark or Distributed Data Processing Frameworks   Cloud Data Platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)   Data Pipeline Development and Orchestration   Git and Version Control   Command Line/Terminal Fundamentals   Data Quality, Validation, and Testing Practices   Data Governance, Security, and Privacy Fundamentals   Software Development and Data Engineering Best Practices     Desired skills:     Previous experience as a technical instructor, trainer, educator, teaching assistant, or mentor   Experience leading technical workshops, bootcamps, or training programs   Experience reviewing code and data engineering projects   Experience building and maintaining enterprise data pipelines   Experience coaching junior data professionals or early-career technology talent   Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, or similar modern data platforms   Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data engineering solutions   Exposure to machine learning workflows, MLOps, or AI/Generative AI technologies   Experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka, Event Hubs, or Kinesis   Curriculum development or instructional design experience     Preferred Technical Stack:     Python   SQL   Databricks   Apache Spark   Azure Data Factory   Azure Synapse Analytics   Snowflake   Delta Lake   Power BI   Azure Storage Services   Git/GitHub   CI/CD Pipelines   Data Modeling Tools and Techniques     Pay range: $55.00 - $75.00 per hour   Only candidates available and ready to work directly as Genesis10 employees will be considered for this position.   If you have the described qualifications and are interested in this exciting opportunity, please apply!   Benefits of Working with Genesis10:     Medical, Dental, Vision   Health Savings Account   Voluntary Hospital Indemnity (Critical Illness & Accident)   Voluntary Term Life Insurance   401K   Sick Pay (for applicable states/municipalities)   Commuter Benefits (Dallas, NYC, SF, and Illinois)   Fun & flexible team environment         Genesis10 is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

The role requires strong proficiency in Python, SQL Server, Oracle, Tableau, Splunk, statistical inference, and machine learning fundamentals. The candidate will translate ambiguous business requirements into actionable data problems, build production-quality data pipelines and dashboards, monitor deployed solutions for performance issues and data drift, and communicate findings effectively to Product Owners, VPs, and other stakeholders. Key Responsibilities •    Analyze large and complex operational datasets using Python, SQL, and statistical methods to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights. •    Develop data analysis and machine learning solutions using Python libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and at least one of statsmodels, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. •    Apply statistical inference and hypothesis testing to investigate business and operational questions. •    Develop and evaluate machine learning models for classification, regression, clustering, and tree-based modeling. •    Query and analyze data from SQL Server and Oracle databases, with exposure to Snowflake where applicable. •    Build, optimize, and maintain Tableau dashboards that are user-friendly, performant, and suitable for executive audiences. •    Develop Splunk SPL searches and dashboards using operational data. •    Build and maintain production-quality data pipelines, dashboards, and reusable code rather than one-off scripts. •    Use Git/GitLab for version control and maintain well-documented, maintainable code. •    Monitor deployed pipelines, dashboards, and models to identify data drift, performance issues, and operational problems. •    Translate ambiguous business requests into clearly defined, actionable data problems and deliver practical solutions independently. •    Present findings, recommendations, and technical insights to non-technical stakeholders, Product Owners, and VP-level audiences. Required Qualifications •    Strong proficiency in Python, including pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn, plus experience with at least one of statsmodels, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. •    Experience working with SQL Server and Oracle; Snowflake experience is an advantage. •    Experience developing and optimizing Tableau dashboards for usability, performance, and executive reporting. •    Experience with Splunk SPL searches and dashboard development using operational data. •    Strong understanding of statistical inference and hypothesis testing on large, complex operational datasets. •    Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, including classification, regression, clustering, and tree-based models. •    Experience with Git/GitLab version control and writing maintainable, documented code. •    Strong communication skills and the ability to present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. •    Ability to work independently, clarify ambiguous business requirements, and deliver production-quality data solutions. Preferred Qualifications •    Experience in telecommunications, cable, or call center operations. •    Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP), including transformers, Hugging Face, topic modeling, embeddings, or semantic search. •    Experience with MLOps tools and practices, including Prefect, Airflow, Docker, or GitLab CI/CD. •    Experience with time-series analysis involving high-volume event data. •    Familiarity with vector databases such as ChromaDB, Pinecone, or FAISS. •    Experience with Alteryx, including migration of workflows to Python, or tools such as Streamlit. •    Experience with REST APIs for platforms such as Jira, Tableau, or Splunk. •    Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Google Cloud Storage (GCS), AWS, or Azure. •    Experience with Snowflake.

skills.source: Job Summary We are seeking a Full Stack Java Developer to support and enhance enterprise investment servicing applications. The role focuses on developing Java-based solutions, building and optimizing Oracle database components, designing ETL workflows, and supporting critical data integrations across investment operations. Key Responsibilities •    Design, develop, and maintain Java applications and JSP-based components supporting investment operations. •    Build and optimize Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, and stored procedures for high-volume data processing. •    Develop and maintain ETL workflows to integrate internal and external data sources. •    Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to support investment servicing processes and data requirements. •    Develop automation and operational tools using Python or other scripting languages. •    Troubleshoot production issues and improve application performance, reliability, and scalability. •    Participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment activities while promoting engineering best practices. •    Support data integration and processing activities across enterprise investment servicing applications. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Software Development Engineer II   Location(s):  Seattle, WA       Job Summary  The Personalization and Discovery Growth team builds scalable marketing technology systems that power paid media campaigns across digital and social channels. This role focuses on developing innovative solutions that support customer acquisition, content discovery, and subscriber growth at global scale.   The Software Development Engineer will work across the full campaign lifecycle, developing AI-powered automation, integrating advertising technology platforms, building data pipelines for measurement and attribution, and creating campaign management tools to support optimization and reporting. The role also involves developing multi-agent systems and AI copilots, collaborating with Applied Scientists on machine learning features, and building reliable monitoring and alerting infrastructure.   The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in computer science, experience with distributed systems and data engineering, and familiarity with marketing technology or advertising technology platforms. Strong written communication, attention to detail, independent problem-solving, and the ability to deliver results in a fast-paced environment are essential.     Responsibilities     Build AI-powered automation for campaign creation and scheduling using agentic frameworks and large language models (LLMs).   Develop integrations with advertising technology platforms to support campaign activation and delivery.   Design and develop data pipelines for real-time measurement, attribution, and campaign performance analytics.   Build campaign management tools and workflows to support optimization and iterative improvements.   Develop multi-agent systems and AI copilots that streamline campaign ideation, execution, and performance reporting.   Collaborate with Applied Scientists to develop machine learning-powered features, including audience optimization and incrementality measurement.   Build monitoring and alerting infrastructure to ensure high availability and reliability of marketing operations.   Contribute to system design, architecture decisions, and code reviews to improve software quality, scalability, and reliability.     Required Qualifications     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.   3+ years of professional software development experience, excluding internships.   2+ years of experience in software design or architecture, including design patterns, reliability, and scalability of new and existing systems.   2+ years of experience with big data technologies such as AWS, Spark, or Hadoop.   Proficiency in Java and/or Python.   Experience with AWS services, including Step Functions, S3, Redshift, Lambda, and EMR.   Experience with distributed systems and data pipeline development.     Preferred Qualifications     Experience developing AI-native systems.   Familiarity with agentic frameworks and Amazon Bedrock.   Experience with advertising technology platforms and campaign management systems.   Familiarity with AWS Clean Rooms.   Experience with TypeScript.       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

evidence.text: Fidelity pipeline monitoring and audit trails for encrypted insurance transfer compliance.

skills.label: Java
skills.source: Job ID: 112645-1  Title: Java Full Stack Developer (F2F) (LOCAL)   Locations: Onsite: Whippany NJ  Duration: 6+ Months with Possible Extension.  Pay Range: $40-$48/Hour on W2      Requested:  Local to Whippany NJ only!  Need to be able to do face to face interview   Skills:  Java, Spring, Spring boot, Microservices, Angular, Grid API, SSIS, PL Script, SQL, Oracle   Experience Required:  6-8     Summary:  A Java Full Stack Developer is proficient in both front-end and back-end development, leveraging Java technologies to build robust, scalable, and user-friendly web applications. Below is a breakdown of the essential technologies and tools that form the tech stack for a Java Full Stack Developer:     Required Skills   Back-End Technologies   •Java Programming : Core Java concepts like object-oriented programming, multithreading, and collections are fundamental.   •Spring Framework:  A powerful framework for building enterprise-level applications, including Spring Boot for microservices and RESTful APIs.   •Microservices:  For creating APIs that enable communication between client and server.  Database Management   •SQL Databases:  Proficiency in databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle for structured data storage.     Front-End Technologies   •HTML and CSS:  For structuring and styling web pages, ensuring responsive and visually appealing designs.   •JavaScript:  Adds interactivity and dynamic behavior to web pages. Frameworks like React, Angular are often used for building modern user interfaces.   •Accessibility Standards:  Ensures web applications are usable by individuals with disabilities, promoting inclusivity.  Development Tools   •Integrated Development Environments (IDEs):  Tools like Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA, or NetBeans for efficient coding and debugging.  •Version Control Systems: Tools like Git and platforms like GitHub or GitLab for managing code changes and collaboration.   •Build Tools:  Tools like Maven or Gradle for project management and dependency resolution.     Deployment and DevOps   •Docker and Kubernetes:  For containerization and orchestration of applications.   •Jenkins:  For continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).   •Cloud Platforms:  Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform for scalable application hosting.     Testing and Debugging   •JUnit:  A unit testing framework for Java applications.   •Debugging Tools:  Proficiency in identifying and resolving code issues using breakpoints and runtime analysis.     Additional Skills   •Web Security:  Knowledge of security protocols like OAuth, JWT, and API security best practices.   •Caching:  Techniques using tools like Redis to improve application performance.  •Design Patterns: Understanding reusable solutions like dependency injection and factory patterns for efficient software design.   •Client Co-Pilot :  Knowledge in create/modify project project and able to handle mode and models     Soft Skills and Collaboration   •Teamwork and Communication:  Essential for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.   •Agile Methodologies:  Experience with frameworks like Scrum or Kanban for iterative development.  By mastering this tech stack, a Java Full Stack Developer can build end-to-end applications that are efficient, secure, and user-friendly, meeting both client and business requirements.     Company Benefits & Culture  •    Inclusive and diverse work environment  •    Opportunities for professional growth and development  •    Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Position Overview   We are seeking passionate and seasoned professionals to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will help design, develop, and scale AI-enabling platform services and public APIs that are secure, reliable, and cloud-native. These services will act as foundational building blocks for AI adoption across our product portfolio and partner ecosystem.   You will be part of a Scrum team to build innovative, standards-compliant, secure, and production-grade AI capabilities, with a builder mindset, rapid prototyping, and continuous improvement with the agility of a start-up.   Key Responsibilities     Collaborate with multiple teams to create AI solutions, including AI model deployment, training, and AI tooling development.   Build scalable, fault-tolerant cloud-native services on Azure, ensuring high performance and reliability.   Develop secure, well-documented public APIs and SDKs for consumption by internal and external developers.   Work with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end solutions across data pipelines, orchestration, and service APIs.   Embed robust security controls to protect sensitive data and ensure secure access to AI services.     Essential Requirements     Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and understanding trade-offs between performance, cost, and capability.   Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and tool calling.   Familiarity with AI standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A).   Proficiency in developing code using AI Tools such as GitHub Copilot and prompt engineering.   Experience in Python and AI frameworks/tools such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.   Experience with tools for automated testing and evaluation of AI outputs.   Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical challenges and propose scalable solutions.     Desired Skills and Competencies     Extensive experience in software engineering, preferably in platform or cloud-native service development using C# and .NET technologies.   Strong expertise in RESTful API design, versioning, testing, and lifecycle management.   Strong knowledge or experience in working with various ML algorithms (regression, classification, clustering, deep learning).   Proficient in securing APIs, managing authentication/authorization, and data privacy practices.   Hands-on experience with Azure and associated PaaS services; experience with other cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) is also valued.   Knowledge of AI ethics and regulations and commitment to responsible AI development.   Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating across global R&D locations.     Research & Development   Our global team of developers works on a diverse portfolio of industrial automation and engineering products. AI and cloud are at the center of our strategy, and we have a strong track record of innovation. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.   Benefits   Enjoy flexible work hours, generous PTO, paid volunteering days, parental leave, well-being support, medical, dental, vision, and 401K. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are comprehensive.   Working Arrangement   We work in a hybrid way, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection.

The primary focus of this role is supporting the migration of the existing portal from Drupal 10 to Drupal 11, maintaining custom Drupal modules, addressing vulnerabilities, applying patches, and resolving application issues. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with both Drupal development and the Acquia Cloud platform, along with strong backend development capabilities.    Key Responsibilities  •    Support the migration and upgrade of the external developer portal from Drupal 10 to Drupal 11.  •    Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Drupal-based applications hosted on Acquia Cloud.  •    Manage and enhance custom Drupal modules and contributed modules.  •    Support backend development, including customizations and PHP-based Drupal coding as required.  •    Perform vulnerability remediation, security patching, bug fixes, and routine application maintenance.  •    Participate in Agile sprint planning, feature development, and maintenance activities.  •    Troubleshoot migration issues and help ensure the portal remains stable and available throughout the upgrade.  •    Support planned application updates and maintenance activities outside regular business hours when required.  •    Collaborate with existing engineers, participate in knowledge sharing, and contribute to technical documentation.  •    Follow established change management and deployment procedures to minimize disruption to business operations.    Required Qualifications  •    Hands-on experience developing and maintaining applications using Drupal.  •    Practical experience working with the Acquia Cloud platform.  •    Recent experience with modern Drupal versions, preferably Drupal 10 or Drupal 11.  •    Direct experience upgrading or migrating Drupal applications, particularly from Drupal 10 to Drupal 11.  •    Strong backend development skills and experience working with Drupal customizations.  •    Experience troubleshooting application issues, applying patches, and maintaining production websites.  •    Experience with vulnerability remediation, security patching, and application maintenance.  •    Ability to work independently while collaborating with a distributed engineering team.  •    Availability to work during the team's core Central Time business hours.  •    Flexibility to support occasional planned off-hours maintenance.    Preferred Qualifications  •    Experience with PHP and custom Drupal module development.  •    Familiarity with Drupal contributed modules and customized Drupal environments.  •    Experience with Agile development practices, sprint-based delivery, and technical documentation.  •    Acquia Cloud certifications are a plus but are not mandatory.    Project Details and Working Expectations  •    Primary initiative: Support the Drupal 10-to-Drupal 11 migration, with a target deadline in December.  •    Application environment: The portal includes approximately 20 custom Drupal modules and 40 contributed modules.  •    Work arrangement: Fully remote; candidates may be located anywhere in the U.S. and do not need to report to the Riverwoods, Illinois office.  •    Working hours: Must align with the team's Central Time business hours.  •    Off-hours maintenance: Occasional maintenance may be required, typically within a late-evening or overnight window, approximately 9:00 PM to 2:00–3:00 AM, depending on the change. The team anticipates fewer than five such events over the six-month contract, potentially fewer. Weekend work may be avoidable.  •    Schedule flexibility: When off-hours maintenance is required, the engineer may coordinate adjusted working hours during the week. Overtime is not expected.  •    Contract term: Six months, with no guarantee of extension.
