Implement CI/CD processes and address application vulnerabilities, security findings, and compliance requirements.   Troubleshoot application issues, analyze logs, support production systems, and resolve technical problems independently.   Create and maintain observability dashboards using tools such as Splunk, New Relic, or similar monitoring platforms.   Participate in Agile/Kanban ceremonies, daily stand-ups, Jira story tracking, quarterly planning activities, and technical demonstrations.   Collaborate with team members, communicate progress clearly, and provide technical support to unblock others when needed.   Work effectively in a dynamic environment where requirements may evolve and solutions need to be delivered within days or weeks.     Required Skills and Qualifications     Strong hands-on experience in  Python backend development .   Experience designing and developing REST APIs and backend services.   Working knowledge of  React or similar frontend technologies  and the ability to contribute to frontend development.   Experience with SQL, database schemas, data modeling, and data pipeline development.   Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and familiarity with cloud architecture and terminology.   Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation, troubleshooting, and software deployment.   Practical experience using AI-powered development tools, such as Claude Code or comparable AI coding assistants.   Understanding of agentic AI development, AI-powered automation, or integration with existing MCP servers is highly desirable.   Experience with application vulnerability remediation, security findings, and compliance-related engineering tasks.   Familiarity with observability tools such as Splunk, New Relic, or similar platforms.   Experience analyzing application logs and resolving production issues.   Previous experience working with Capital One or similar large enterprise engineering environments.   Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, communication skills, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.   Experience building AI-powered developer productivity tools or agentic AI solutions.     Preferred Qualifications     Familiarity with MCP server integrations and leveraging existing MCP capabilities within applications.   Experience working with Go or maintaining Java-based legacy applications.   Experience building internal engineering tools, notification systems, automated remediation solutions, and operational automation.   Strong presentation skills and the ability to demonstrate completed solutions to technical stakeholders.     Expected Work Distribution     50% – Backend APIs and data:  REST API development, database schemas, datasets, and related data processing.   25% – Security and compliance:  Vulnerability remediation, compliance findings, and related engineering activities.   25% – Frontend and other engineering tasks:  React development, troubleshooting, legacy application maintenance, and production support.    The role is primarily backend-focused. Python is the main development language; Java is being phased out, with any remaining Java work largely limited to maintenance and bug fixes.   Team and Work Environment  The engineer will join a small, collaborative team of approximately 6–8 people. Team members typically own individual tasks but are expected to collaborate, learn quickly, and support colleagues when priorities change.  The team follows a Kanban-based workflow using Jira and conducts regular stand-ups, quarterly planning, and technical demonstrations. Engineers are expected to work with limited documentation, clarify problem statements, iterate quickly, obtain team feedback, and deliver solutions with minimal supervision.  Some production support and monitoring responsibilities may be required, including reviewing logs and resolving issues during the approximate 7:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. support window. This does not imply continuous overnight on-call coverage.

skills.source: Request ID: 113966-1  Title: Python with Agentic AI Engineer  Locations: Alpharetta, GA  Duration: 6 months  Pay Range: $50 - $53/Hour on W2/C2C (All inclusive)    We are seeking a highly skilled Python with Agentic AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy next-generation AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and autonomous workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python development, Generative AI, Agentic AI frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and cloud-native application development.    This role involves building intelligent AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool usage, memory management, and multi-agent collaboration to automate complex business processes and enhance enterprise productivity.    Key Responsibilities    Design and develop AI-powered applications using Python and modern AI frameworks.  Build autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or OpenAI Agents SDK.  Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.  Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and Azure OpenAI into enterprise applications.  Design multi-agent orchestration workflows for complex business use cases.  Implement agent memory, reasoning, tool calling, and workflow automation capabilities.  Develop REST APIs and microservices using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.  Build data pipelines for ingestion, processing, and enrichment of structured and unstructured data. skills.label: Java
skills.source: Job Summary The Java Software Engineer will develop and maintain middleware and web services that connect enterprise systems with customer-facing product lines and business services. The role involves building Java-based applications using Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem, developing and consuming REST APIs, and working with relational databases and cloud-native technologies. The engineer will collaborate with multiple cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable software solutions while leveraging AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and development efficiency. Key Responsibilities •    Design, develop, test, and maintain Java applications using Java 11/17, Spring Boot, and the broader Spring ecosystem. •    Develop, integrate, and consume REST APIs and web services to support middleware and enterprise business services. •    Build and maintain software components that facilitate communication between enterprise systems and customer-facing product lines. •    Work with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms to support application data requirements. •    Develop and maintain applications for cloud environments, with a focus on Microsoft Azure. •    Support containerized application deployments and contribute to migration initiatives from Kubernetes to Azure Container Apps (ACA). •    Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude to improve software development lifecycle activities. •    Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver technical solutions. •    Participate in application design, code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities. •    Follow software development best practices, coding standards, and established development processes. Required Qualifications •    Strong hands-on experience with Java 11/17. •    Experience developing applications using Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem. •    Experience developing and consuming REST APIs and web services. •    Experience working with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar technologies. •    Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. •    Excellent written and verbal communication skills. •    Ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams and stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications •    Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services. •    Experience with Kubernetes and Azure Container Apps (ACA), particularly application migration between container platforms. •    Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and cloud-native application deployment. •    Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude. •    Experience supporting middleware, enterprise integrations, or web services for business applications.

evidence.text: Delivered Fortune 500 Java systems for Fidelity, British Telecom and T-Mobile over 3 years spanning secure insurance exchange, telecom commerce and an AWS operations platform for 3K employees.
